title: 方法与流程
text: 方法与流程 一个像素，两个表面点 沿相机射线，最近和最远的表面交点分别对应前、后表面。HccePose(BF) 预测两个表面的层次化连续坐标编码，并将解码后的三维点与图像像素配对。 论文中的 HccePose(BF) 网络结构与位姿求解流程。 从检测到位姿 YOLO 提供目标区域，HccePose 为对应物体预测掩码及表面坐标。结合匹配分辨率的相机内参，PnP 求解物体到相机的位姿。检测器可以识别多个类别；位姿权重按物体加载。 参阅 论文 和 接口约定 。 层次坐标编码与对应关系 HCCE 分别编码物体坐标的三个分量。网络同时预测掩码和前后表面编码，解码后得到物体坐标系下的三维点。一个前景像素沿相机射线对应最近与最远的两个表面交点，因而可以构建两组 2D–3D 对应。 阶段 数据流 检测与裁剪 YOLO 提供实例区域；图像缩放、补边及裁剪变换决定像素坐标的映射。 网络预测 逐物体网络预测掩码与前后表面编码。 建立对应 解码三维坐标，与掩码中的像素位置配对。 求解位姿 结合相机内参用 PnP 求解 X_camera = R @ X_model + t 。 检测器可包含多个物体类别，每类可检测多个实例；HccePose 权重按物体分别训练和加载。换新物体的完整流程见 物体准备 、 场景渲染 、 检测器 、 坐标标签 与 位姿训练 。 深度与可选后端 MegaPose 从 HccePose 位姿继续精修，支持纯 RGB 或配准 RGB-D。WAPR 的当前公开接入从原图掩码、配准深度和米制网格估计位姿并评分，不依赖 HccePose 初值。它们不是同一个调用模式，输入与单位对照见 精修接口 。 本文解释已公开方法。论文图保留原貌，数组形状和实际调用以 Tester 、 结果字典 为准。

title: Method and pipeline
text: Method and pipeline One pixel, two surface points The nearest and farthest intersections along a camera ray correspond to the front and back surfaces. HccePose(BF) predicts hierarchical continuous coordinate codes for both surfaces and pairs the decoded 3D points with image pixels. HccePose(BF) network architecture and pose estimation pipeline, from the published paper. From detection to pose YOLO supplies object regions. HccePose predicts masks and surface coordinates for the corresponding object. PnP uses image-matched intrinsics to recover the object-to-camera pose. One detector can identify multiple categories; pose weights are loaded per object. See the paper and API contract . Hierarchical coordinates and correspondences HCCE encodes the three object-coordinate components separately. The network predicts masks and front/back surface codes, which decode to 3D points in the object coordinate system. A foreground pixel corresponds to the nearest and farthest intersections along its camera ray, providing two sets of 2D–3D correspondences. Stage Data flow Detect and crop YOLO proposes instance regions; resizing, padding and crop transforms define pixel mappings. Predict Per-object networks estimate masks and front/back codes. Match Decode 3D coordinates and associate them with masked pixel locations. Solve Use pixel intrinsics and PnP to estimate X_camera = R @ X_model + t . A detector may recognize several categories and multiple instances per category. HccePose checkpoints are trained and loaded per object. For a new object, follow mesh preparation , rendering , detector training , coordinate labels and pose training . Depth and optional backends MegaPose refines HccePose poses using RGB or registered RGB-D. The current public WAPR integration estimates poses and scores from original-image masks, registered depth and meter meshes, without HccePose pose seeds. These are distinct entry points; see refinement interfaces for inputs and units. This page explains the published method. The original paper figure is preserved. See Tester and results for actual calls and array shapes.

title: 环境安装
text:
环境安装 使用 Python 3.10 与支持 CUDA 的 NVIDIA GPU。在项目根目录运行以下命令；模型权重需单独准备。 先克隆公开项目并进入根目录，再安装依赖： BASH git clone https://github.com/WangYuLin-SEU/HCCEPose.git cd HCCEPose 应用入口位于 examples/inference/ ，公开训练与渲染阶段脚本仍保留在根目录。 HccePose 环境 根据驱动选择适用的 PyTorch CUDA 安装方式 ，再安装本包依赖： BASH python -m pip install -r requirements-inference.txt
python -m zipfile -e bop_toolkit.zip . 工具包解压后应存在 bop_toolkit/bop_toolkit_lib/ 。接下来按 资源说明 准备匹配的检测器和各物体的位姿权重。 可选 WAPR RGB-D 示例使用 这个固定提交的 WAPR 源码 。请在本项目以外的工作目录中使用 Git、Python 3.10 和 Bash 执行以下命令。生成的 wheel 带有本地编译所需的源码。 BASH git clone --no-checkout https://github.com/WangYuLin-SEU/WAPR.git WAPR-source
git -C WAPR-source checkout --detach 4e591be318a828c91980c58ef8bbdc34e6599881
python -m pip install "setuptools>=77" "wheel>=0.45" ( cd WAPR-source && WAPR_WHEEL_SOURCE_ONLY = 1 python wheel_build/build_wheel.py ) python -m pip install WAPR-source/wheel_build/dist/wapr-0.0.11-py3-none-any.whl 如在另一台机器构建，将上述 wheel 复制到目标机，把最后一条安装命令中的路径改为目标机上的位置，在 HccePose 使用的同一 Python 环境 中安装。目标机需备好含 nvcc 的 CUDA toolkit、C++ 编译器和支持 CUDA 的 PyTorch。Linux 上的 OpenGL 渲染器还需要 EGL/OpenGL 开发头文件。随后准备位姿估计组件： BASH python -m wapr.bootstrap --feature core WAPR 默认将资源放在用户缓存目录中的 wapr/ ，可选的 WAPR_CACHE_DIR 必须是绝对路径；配置组件和运行推理时应使用同一个值。该目录独立于 HccePose 的 data/ 和 Torch Hub 缓存。以上构建命令使用 Bash；Windows 可使用 Git Bash，并按上游要求准备 MSVC 与 CUDA，不能直接将 Bash 子命令粘贴到 PowerShell。 首次配置需联网下载公开权重和依赖。请在目标 GPU 上用配套模型和实际输入验证完整流程。详见 该版本 WAPR 的安装说明 。 公开训练与渲染源码 物体准备、PBR 渲染、标签生成、检测器训练、位姿训练和 BOP 评测脚本已保留在项目根目录。教程源码链接标明原始公开设置；如需使用该历史版本，可另建独立副本： BASH git clone https://github.com/WangYuLin-SEU/HCCEPose.git HCCEPose-upstream cd HCCEPose-upstream
git checkout --detach f75cc4d5db2fc298fc7b853f8c75273757872382
python -m zipfile -e bop_toolkit.zip . 这些脚本位于该目录根部，如 s1_p1_obj_rename_center.py 、 s4_p2_train_bf_pbr.py ；它们不在当前项目的 examples/inference/ 中。教程链接均指向公开固定版本。阅读各脚本顶部的输入要求，修改用户数据路径后再运行。 训练和渲染的依赖多于纯推理。PyMeshLab 用于网格预处理，KASAL 用于对称信息；BlenderProc 与 bpy 用于 PBR 渲染。需要渲染时在上游源码根目录执行： BASH python -m zipfile -e blenderproc.zip .
python -m pip install bpy == 3 .6.0 --extra-index-url https://download.blender.org/pypi/ Ubuntu 的 EGL/OpenGL 开发依赖、显卡驱动和 CUDA 必须与选用的软件版本匹配。独立准备训练/渲染环境，不要将上述额外组件作为所有推理用户的必需依赖。各阶段的公开参数与目录见 项目结构 。 MegaPose 与网络加速 MegaPose 可能在首次调用时克隆公开源码，创建 .envs/megapose/ Python 3.9 子环境并下载模型。请确保 Conda 可用、源码目录可写；不要把所有 MegaPose 依赖混装到主环境。用法见 MegaPose 教程 。 ONNX / TensorRT 选择会触发后端环境检查，可能安装依赖、导出模型或构建缓存。需要兼容的 CUDA、ONNX Runtime 和 TensorRT 运行库，详见 加速说明 。纯 PyTorch RGB 推理不要求安装这些可选后端。

title: Installation
text:
Installation Use Python 3.10 and an NVIDIA GPU with CUDA support. Run the following commands from the project root. Prepare model weights separately. Clone the public project and enter its root before installing dependencies: BASH git clone https://github.com/WangYuLin-SEU/HCCEPose.git cd HCCEPose Application entry points are in examples/inference/ ; public training and rendering stage scripts remain in the root. HccePose environment Install CUDA-enabled PyTorch suitable for your driver, then install the package dependencies: BASH python -m pip install -r requirements-inference.txt
python -m zipfile -e bop_toolkit.zip . Extraction must create bop_toolkit/bop_toolkit_lib/ . Next, prepare the matching detector and per-object pose weights described in resource preparation . Optional WAPR The RGB-D example uses the pinned WAPR source . To build its wheel, run the following Bash commands with Git and Python 3.10 in a working directory outside this project. The wheel contains the sources for the native components. BASH git clone --no-checkout https://github.com/WangYuLin-SEU/WAPR.git WAPR-source
git -C WAPR-source checkout --detach 4e591be318a828c91980c58ef8bbdc34e6599881
python -m pip install "setuptools>=77" "wheel>=0.45" ( cd WAPR-source && WAPR_WHEEL_SOURCE_ONLY = 1 python wheel_build/build_wheel.py ) python -m pip install WAPR-source/wheel_build/dist/wapr-0.0.11-py3-none-any.whl If you build on a different machine, copy the wheel named above to the target and run the last installation command with its local path in the same Python environment as HccePose . On the target, prepare a CUDA toolkit with nvcc , a C++ compiler and CUDA-enabled PyTorch. On Linux the OpenGL renderer also needs EGL/OpenGL development headers. Then prepare the pose estimation components: BASH python -m wapr.bootstrap --feature core WAPR stores resources under wapr/ in the user cache directory by default. The optional WAPR_CACHE_DIR must be an absolute path; use the same value for component setup and inference. This directory is separate from HccePose’s data/ and the Torch Hub cache. The build commands above use Bash. On Windows, use Git Bash and prepare MSVC and CUDA as required upstream; do not paste the Bash subshell command directly into PowerShell. The first setup needs network access to fetch the published weights and dependencies. Test the complete setup on the target GPU with your models and inputs. See the setup notes for this WAPR revision . Public training and rendering source Object preparation, PBR rendering, labeling, detector training, pose training and BOP evaluation scripts are included in the project root. Tutorial source links identify the original published settings. To work specifically with that historical revision, optionally use a separate checkout: BASH git clone https://github.com/WangYuLin-SEU/HCCEPose.git HCCEPose-upstream cd HCCEPose-upstream
git checkout --detach f75cc4d5db2fc298fc7b853f8c75273757872382
python -m zipfile -e bop_toolkit.zip . Stage scripts such as s1_p1_obj_rename_center.py and s4_p2_train_bf_pbr.py live in that root, alongside the current project’s application examples in examples/inference/ . Tutorial links use the fixed public revision. Read the input requirements and edit user data paths before launching each stage. Training and rendering require more dependencies than inference. PyMeshLab prepares meshes, KASAL describes symmetries, and BlenderProc with bpy renders PBR scenes. For rendering, run in the upstream root: BASH python -m zipfile -e blenderproc.zip .
python -m pip install bpy == 3 .6.0 --extra-index-url https://download.blender.org/pypi/ Ubuntu EGL/OpenGL development libraries, drivers and CUDA must match your software choices. Prepare training/rendering environments separately rather than making all these components mandatory for inference. See Project structure for stages, public parameters and layouts. MegaPose and network acceleration First use of MegaPose may clone public source, create a Python 3.9 environment under .envs/megapose/ , and download models. Ensure Conda is available and the source directory is writable. Keep MegaPose dependencies separate from the main environment; see the MegaPose tutorial . ONNX / TensorRT selection triggers environment checks that may install packages, export networks or build caches. Compatible CUDA, ONNX Runtime and TensorRT libraries are required; see acceleration . Plain PyTorch RGB inference does not require these optional backends.

), encoding = "utf-8" ) as handle : camera = json . load ( handle ) cam_K = [[ camera [ "fx" ], 0 , camera [ "cx" ]], [ 0 , camera [ "fy" ], camera [ "cy" ]], [ 0 , 0 , 1 ]] camera_path = os . path . join ( capture_dir , "000003_camera_matrix.json" ) with open ( camera_path , "w" , encoding = "utf-8" ) as handle : json . dump ( cam_K , handle , indent = 2 ) 该调用只读取公开资源，不需要登录。 local_dir 决定资源实际位置， data/.cache/huggingface/ 存储下载元数据；再次运行可复用已有文件并重新校验。清单中的大小和权重摘要对应上述固定 HF 版本，共下载七个文件，不含训练 ZIP 或对称性辅助文件。校验失败时先检查报出的文件，再重新下载；示例不会自动删除现有文件。 best_score/ 中只应有清单指定的无后缀 checkpoint，不要改名、解压或放入说明文件。 确认资源损坏后，可在该下载调用中加入 force_download=True 强制重新下载；额外 checkpoint 或说明文件需自行检查后移出 best_score/ 。 RGB 和深度分别位于 data/test_imgs_RGBD/000003_rgb.png 、 data/test_imgs_RGBD/000003_depth.png ，相机数组是新生成的 data/test_imgs_RGBD/000003_camera_matrix.json 。不要将 demo-bin-picking/camera.json 套用到这帧：它的分辨率和内参不同。运行方式见 第一次预测 与 WAPR 接入 。 下载工具也提供最小示例预设： BASH python scripts/download_hf_assets.py --preset demo --dest data --endpoint hf 它使用同一固定七文件清单，校验后另存相机矩阵。其他预设未指定 --dest 时仍写入旧阶段脚本使用的项目根目录，wget 备用入口也使用该旧布局。选择较大的训练预设前，可先查看 python scripts/download_hf_assets.py --help 。 离线准备 RGB 推理 默认网络先用 torchvision 权重初始化 ResNet-34，再加载各物体的 HccePose 权重。可先在联网机器上使用新的 Torch Hub 缓存，下载主干权重并查看缓存目录： BASH python -c "from torchvision.models import ResNet34_Weights; ResNet34_Weights.IMAGENET1K_V1.get_state_dict(check_hash=True)" python -c "from pathlib import Path; import torch; print(Path(torch.hub.get_dir()) / 'checkpoints')" 在 目标机 执行第二条命令，将 resnet34-b627a593.pth 复制到输出的目录。torchvision 在下载时校验公开的 SHA-256 前缀 b627a593 。复制后再比对两台机器上文件的完整 SHA-256。参阅 torchvision ResNet-34 权重说明 。 图像和相机 彩色图使用 OpenCV 的 BGR 顺序。 camera.json 为与原图分辨率对应的 3×3 数组，单位为像素。 深度图必须事先与彩色图完成像素配准。WAPR 接口接收米制深度；整数毫米图应显式乘以 1e-3 。尺寸相同并不代表已经配准。 其他公开数据与训练资源 运行单图和 WAPR 示例只需上面的七文件清单。需要其他任务时按目录选择资源，不要无差别下载完整数据仓库。 任务 公开目录或文件 料箱模型、权重与训练数据 demo-bin-picking 纹理物体模型与权重 demo-tex-objs 图片输入 test_imgs 视频输入 test_videos 配准 RGB-D 帧 test_imgs_RGBD 材质库 cc0textures-512.zip 七个 BOP 数据集权重 BOP 评测与权重索引 Hugging Face 的 local_dir 保留上游层级。例如下载 demo-tex-objs/ 后，它本身才是对应数据集根目录；不要再额外包一层同名目录。训练 ZIP 与无后缀 checkpoint 是不同类型：ZIP 按训练教程解压，checkpoint 保留原文件名直接由加载器读取。 自己的数据应使用清晰的外部数据根目录，由该根构造模型、训练场景和标签路径。物体模型采用毫米，深度换算按对应采集元数据，而非根据文件扩展名猜测。制作新模型的完整流程见 物体准备 。

title: Models and inputs
text:
Models and inputs Matching resources Meshes, model metadata, detector class order and per-object pose weights must match. Published resources are available from the HCCEPose resource page . Application captures and weights are not bundled. dataset_root follows the published loader layout: TEXT objects/
  models/models_info.json
  models/obj_000001.ply
  yolo11/train_obj_s/detection/obj_s/yolo11-detection-obj_s.pt
  HccePose/obj_01/best_score/ Tester loads every object listed in models_info.json during initialization, so prepare pose weights for each object and keep the object order in that file consistent with the detector’s class order. The object ID list passed to predict only selects objects for the current prediction; it does not limit which models are loaded at initialization. Set the dataset path, object IDs and image paths in the entry script. Use detector and pose checkpoints from a trusted source that permits your intended use. Check their hashes against the provider’s records before loading them. Download one RGB-D example After installation , save the following code as a Python script at the project root and run it. Assets go under data/ , preserving the Hugging Face layout. Use data/demo-bin-picking/ as dataset_root ; there is no need to rename it to objects/ . PYTHON import hashlib import json import os from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download project_dir = os . path . dirname ( os . path . abspath ( __file__ )) data_root = os . path . join ( project_dir , "data" ) # Sizes from the fixed public revision; verify both weights against their LFS SHA-256. checkpoint_relative_path = "demo-bin-picking/HccePose/obj_01/best_score/0_9837step824500" required_files = { "demo-bin-picking/models/models_info.json" : ( 941 , None ), "demo-bin-picking/models/obj_000001.ply" : ( 128911 , None ), checkpoint_relative_path : ( 349827430 , "3308469a5082feb98181286026003e0b00ea8a349b8f0921006873a177dd4c70" ), "demo-bin-picking/yolo11/train_obj_s/detection/obj_s/yolo11-detection-obj_s.pt" : ( 114453888 , "5a958cf1d90d3529f02ba1021aab164a369316f187f98fb01b151c484d3cfd13" ), "test_imgs_RGBD/000003_rgb.png" : ( 208215 , None ), "test_imgs_RGBD/000003_depth.png" : ( 59239 , None ), "test_imgs_RGBD/000003_camK.json" : ( 184 , None ), } # Share one seven-file list between downloading and validation; omit training ZIPs and symmetry helpers. snapshot_download ( repo_id = "SEU-WYL/HccePose" , repo_type = "dataset" , revision = "4e482e540314622981ccd4fce5beddac7f9d3e1d" , local_dir = data_root , allow_patterns = list ( required_files ), endpoint = "https://huggingface.co" , token = False , ) # The loader scans every regular file here; report extras without deleting them. checkpoint_path = os . path . join ( data_root , * checkpoint_relative_path . split ( "/" )) checkpoint_dir = os . path . dirname ( checkpoint_path ) extra_files = [ os . path . join ( checkpoint_dir , name ) for name in os . listdir ( checkpoint_dir ) if os . path . isfile ( os . path . join ( checkpoint_dir , name )) and name != os . path . basename ( checkpoint_path )] if extra_files : raise RuntimeError ( "Unexpected checkpoint files: " + ", " . join ( sorted ( extra_files ))) # The SDK may return a local folder when offline; validate before converting the camera. for relative_path , ( expected_size , expected_sha256 ) in required_files . items (): path = os . path . join ( data_root , * relative_path . split ( "/" )) if not os . path . isfile ( path ): raise FileNotFoundError ( path ) actual_size = os . path . getsize ( path ) if actual_size != expected_size : raise RuntimeError ( f "File size mismatch: { path } ; expected { expected_size } , got { actual_size } " ) if expected_sha256 is not None : digest = hashlib . sha256 () with open ( path , "rb" ) as handle : while True : chunk = handle . read ( 1024 * 1024 ) if not chunk : break digest . update ( chunk ) if digest . hexdigest () != expected_sha256 : raise RuntimeError ( f "SHA-256 mismatch: { path } " ) # Use this frame's intrinsics; convert the field-based JSON to the entry's 3×3 array. capture_dir = os . path . join ( data_root , "test_imgs_RGBD" ) with open ( os . path . join ( capture_dir , "000003_camK.json" ), encoding = "utf-8" ) as handle : camera = json . load ( handle ) cam_K = [[ camera [ "fx" ], 0 , camera [ "cx" ]], [ 0 , camera [ "fy" ], camera [ "cy" ]], [ 0 , 0 , 1 ]] camera_path = os . path . join ( capture_dir , "000003_camera_matrix.json" ) with open ( camera_path , "w" , encoding = "utf-8" ) as handle : json . dump ( cam_K , handle , indent = 2 ) This call accesses public resources without login. local_dir determines where files are stored; data/.cache/huggingface/ holds download metadata. Reruns reuse existing files and validate them again. The sizes and weight digests refer to the fixed HF revision above. Exactly seven files are selected, excluding training ZIPs and symmetry helpers. If validation fails, inspect the reported file before downloading it again; the example does not delete existing files. Keep only the specified extensionless checkpoint in best_score/ : do not rename or extract it, or add documentation files there. After confirming a file is damaged, add force_download=True to the download call to fetch it again. Inspect any extra checkpoints or documentation files before moving them out of best_score/ yourself. The RGB and depth files are data/test_imgs_RGBD/000003_rgb.png and data/test_imgs_RGBD/000003_depth.png . The converted camera array is data/test_imgs_RGBD/000003_camera_matrix.json . Do not substitute demo-bin-picking/camera.json for this frame: it has different intrinsics and resolution. Continue with your first prediction or WAPR integration . The existing download tool also provides a minimal preset: BASH python scripts/download_hf_assets.py --preset demo --dest data --endpoint hf It uses the same fixed seven-file manifest, validates it and writes the separate camera matrix. Other presets retain the legacy project-root layout unless --dest is supplied; the wget fallback also writes that legacy root layout. See python scripts/download_hf_assets.py --help before selecting larger training presets. Preparing RGB inference offline The default network initializes a torchvision ResNet-34 before it loads each object's HccePose checkpoint. On a connected machine, preload the backbone into a fresh Torch Hub cache and print its checkpoint directory: BASH python -c "from torchvision.models import ResNet34_Weights; ResNet34_Weights.IMAGENET1K_V1.get_state_dict(check_hash=True)" python -c "from pathlib import Path; import torch; print(Path(torch.hub.get_dir()) / 'checkpoints')" Copy resnet34-b627a593.pth into the checkpoint directory printed by the second command on the target machine . Torchvision checks the published SHA-256 prefix b627a593 on download. Compare the full SHA-256 digest on both machines after copying. Torchvision ResNet-34 weights Images and camera Color images use OpenCV BGR order. camera.json is a 3×3 array of pixel intrinsics matching the original image resolution. Depth must already be registered to the color image. WAPR expects meters; explicitly multiply integer millimeter depth by 1e-3 . Identical dimensions alone do not establish registration. Other public data and training resources The seven-file manifest above is sufficient for the image and WAPR examples. Select additional resources by task rather than downloading the complete dataset repository. Task Public directory or file Bin-picking models, weights and training data demo-bin-picking Textured-object models and weights demo-tex-objs Image inputs test_imgs Video inputs test_videos Registered RGB-D frames test_imgs_RGBD Textures cc0textures-512.zip Seven BOP dataset weights BOP evaluation and weight index Hugging Face local_dir retains upstream paths. After downloading demo-tex-objs/ , that directory is the dataset root; do not nest another copy of its name. Training ZIP files and extensionless checkpoints are different: extract ZIPs following the training tutorial, while keeping checkpoint filenames intact for direct loading. For your own data, expose one external root and derive mesh, scene and label paths from it. Models use millimeters. Convert depth according to capture metadata rather than guessing from the extension. See object preparation for the full new-model workflow.

title: 第一次预测
text: 第一次预测 在包含 examples/inference/ 的项目根目录操作。先完成 环境安装 和 资源准备 。 RGB 示例 编辑 examples/inference/predict_image.py 末尾的资源路径和物体编号，再执行： BASH python examples/inference/predict_image.py 结果保存于 outputs/rgb/ ，包含检测框和标准位姿可视化。也可在 Python 应用中调用： PYTHON from examples.inference.predict_image import main # 路径指向自己准备的图像、内参及配套模型。 results = main ( "data/demo-bin-picking" , "data/test_imgs_RGBD/000003_rgb.png" , "data/test_imgs_RGBD/000003_camera_matrix.json" , [ 1 ], "outputs/rgb" ) 这一步需要匹配的权重与支持 CUDA 的 GPU 环境。

title: Your first prediction

RGB example Edit the resource paths and object IDs at the end of examples/inference/predict_image.py , then run: BASH python examples/inference/predict_image.py Outputs go to outputs/rgb/ , including detection and standard pose visualizations. Applications may also call: PYTHON from examples.inference.predict_image import main # Use your own image, intrinsics and matching model resources. results = main ( "data/demo-bin-picking" , "data/test_imgs_RGBD/000003_rgb.png" , "data/test_imgs_RGBD/000003_camera_matrix.json" , [ 1 ], "outputs/rgb" ) This step requires matching weights and a CUDA-capable GPU environment.

title: 常见问题
text: 故障排查 如果不确定问题是否来自自己的图像或模型，先在 HccePose 主环境中运行 PyTorch RGB 示例 ，使用配套权重、图像和相机内参。 安装与导入 现象 检查与处理 No module named bop_toolkit 在仓库根目录解压 bop_toolkit.zip ，确认能看到 bop_toolkit/bop_toolkit_lib/ ，再从根目录运行示例。见 环境安装 。 All ufuncs must have type numpy.ufunc 确认运行脚本的 Python 解释器，再在对应环境里安装兼容的 NumPy 和 SciPy。Python 3.10 参考环境使用 NumPy 1.26.4 和 SciPy 1.15.3 。 import cv2 时出现 numpy.core.multiarray 或 _ARRAY_API 按 安装文档 统一 OpenCV 和 NumPy 版本；混用不同 NumPy 主版本与二进制 wheel 可能导致导入失败。 缺少 torch.amp 使用 HccePose 主环境中的 PyTorch 2.x 运行根目录示例。 .envs/megapose/bin/python 属于独立的 MegaPose 子进程运行环境。 CUDA 不可用，或显示“Using CPU”后报错 用下面的命令检查 PyTorch 能否识别显卡。即使打印了这条提示， Tester 仍会将模型几何数据送入 CUDA，推理需要可用的 GPU 环境。 EGL/OpenGL 初始化失败 按 安装文档 检查显卡驱动是否支持 EGL，以及系统图形库是否齐全。渲染、部分可视化和位姿精修都依赖这些库。 可以先查看解释器和 GPU 状态，不启动模型推理： BASH python -c "import sys, torch; print(sys.executable); print(torch.__version__); print(torch.cuda.is_available())" 资源与首次运行 现象 检查与处理 已有 HccePose 权重仍触发 torchvision/ResNet 下载 默认网络构造函数在恢复任务 checkpoint 前调用 models.resnet34(pretrained=True) ，首次初始化仍可能向 PyTorch 缓存下载主干权重。 best_score 中的 checkpoint 显示迭代次数为 0 从正表面模型初始化或继续微调所得的权重可能保留这个计数。可用配套示例图验证权重是否能加载。 结果异常或没有物体 调整模型参数前，依次检查以下内容： 物体与权重。 核对物体 ID、网格和模型元数据，并确认检测器和 HccePose 权重均适用于这个物体。 图像通道。 cv2.imread 得到的图像已经是 Tester.predict 需要的 BGR 格式，可直接传入。 相机内参。 内参应对应输入分辨率。在 Tester 外部裁剪或缩放图像时，记得调整内参。 Tester 会自行处理内部的缩放和补边。 单位。 示例中的 BOP 模型坐标和输出平移用毫米，位姿精修所需的深度图用米。转换时使用相机元数据或传感器实际的深度比例。 检测结果。 查看 2D 输出和所选物体 ID。如果该 ID 下没有实例通过筛选，字典中可能没有对应条目，读取位姿前需检查。 结果字段 说明处理后图像坐标、可选字段和位姿输出； RGB 推理 介绍示例阈值。 可选后端 现象 检查与处理 ONNX 初始化时运行 pip 或改变包版本 设置程序可能在首次运行时安装依赖。建议使用独立环境，涉及的包见 推理加速 。 ONNX Runtime 能导入但没有 CUDA provider ONNX 和 ONNX Runtime 能成功导入时，辅助函数就会返回，即使安装的是 CPU runtime。需要在当前环境中安装适合的 GPU runtime，并查看 session/provider 日志。 缺少 TensorRT execution provider 选用的 ONNX Runtime 构建必须包含 TensorrtExecutionProvider ；仅安装 TensorRT Python 包不能给 ORT 补上缺失的 provider。 列出了 TensorRT provider，但无法加载 libnvinfer 安装匹配的 TensorRT 动态库，在启动 Python 前使库目录可见，并核对 CUDA／驱动／动态库组合。排查可选后端时可继续使用已经跑通的 PyTorch 路径。 MegaPose 首次运行长时间准备文件 准备流程可能克隆 third_party_megapose6d/ ，在 .envs/megapose/ 创建 Python 3.9 环境，安装独立依赖并下载模型。需要 conda、网络、可写目录和足够磁盘空间。见 MegaPose 。 MegaPose 缺少配置文件或 checkpoint 检查目录是否包含上游配置文件和权重。有些镜像只提供 checkpoint。根据下载器或 rclone 的报错补齐缺失文件。 反馈问题时，请附上脚本名、运行命令、Python 解释器路径、所选后端、相关文件路径，以及日志中的第一处异常。如果报错来自 MegaPose 子进程，请保留完整日志，方便查看子进程的调用栈。 WAPR 输入与下载缓存 WAPR 的包、编译环境和资源准备见 安装说明 。本项目使用独立的 estimate_from_masks 接口。遇到错误先检查原图掩码、配准米制深度、相机内参和米制网格；空掩码、无正深度和输出数量错误会报错。 Hugging Face 离线回退可能返回已有目录，因此资源页仍逐项检查七文件大小与两个权重摘要。发现损坏时按 资源页 重新下载；额外旧权重或说明文件需检查后移出 best_score/ ，不会自动删除。 pnp_success=False 表示初始 PnP 未成功，不能把回退单位矩阵当成可靠位姿。默认组合 PnP 缺少 keypoints_ 先验时，会报告 checkpoint 路径；先核对权重与物体、网络架构是否匹配。

title: Troubleshooting
text: Troubleshooting To check whether a problem is specific to your inputs, run the PyTorch RGB demo in the main HccePose environment with the original weights, images and camera matrix. Installation and imports Symptom Check and next action No module named bop_toolkit Extract bop_toolkit.zip at the repository root. Check for bop_toolkit/bop_toolkit_lib/ and run the example from the root. See installation . All ufuncs must have type numpy.ufunc Check which Python executable runs the script. In its environment, install compatible versions of NumPy and SciPy. The Python 3.10 reference uses NumPy 1.26.4 and SciPy 1.15.3 . numpy.core.multiarray or _ARRAY_API error on import cv2 Align OpenCV and NumPy with the reference pins in installation ; mixed NumPy major versions and binary wheels can cause import failures. Missing torch.amp Run the root demo in the main HccePose PyTorch 2.x environment. .envs/megapose/bin/python belongs to the separate MegaPose subprocess runtime. CUDA unavailable, or an error after “Using CPU” Use the command below to check whether PyTorch can see the GPU. Tester moves model geometry to CUDA even after printing this message. Inference requires a working GPU installation. EGL/OpenGL initialization failure Check the EGL-capable GPU driver and system graphics dependencies from installation . Rendering and some visualization/refinement workflows need these beyond Python wheels. To identify the active interpreter and GPU availability without starting inference: BASH python -c "import sys, torch; print(sys.executable); print(torch.__version__); print(torch.cuda.is_available())" Assets and first execution Symptom Check and next action A torchvision/ResNet download starts despite existing HccePose weights The default network constructor calls models.resnet34(pretrained=True) before restoring the task checkpoint. First initialization may therefore download backbone weights into the PyTorch cache. A best_score checkpoint reports iteration 0 A checkpoint initialized or fine-tuned from a front-surface model can retain this iteration count. Try it on the supplied sample images to check that it loads. Outputs look wrong or no object appears Check these before altering model parameters: Object identity and weights: the object ID, mesh/model information, detector, and per-object HccePose checkpoint must describe the same trained object. Image colors: Tester.predict expects OpenCV BGR. Do not apply COLOR_RGB2BGR to an image already loaded by cv2.imread . Camera geometry: use intrinsics for the supplied input resolution. If you resize or crop outside Tester , transform the intrinsics accordingly; internal resizing and padding are handled by Tester . Units: supplied BOP-style model coordinates and pose translations are in millimeters. A refinement depth map must be in meters; use the sample camera metadata or the sensor's actual depth scale. Detection: inspect the 2D output and the selected object ID. Per-object result entries may be absent when no instance survives filtering; callers should check that the entry exists before reading poses. The results reference explains processed-image coordinates, optional fields, and pose outputs. RGB inference documents the example thresholds. Optional backends Symptom Check and next action ONNX setup runs pip or changes package versions On first use, the setup helper can install dependencies. Use a dedicated environment. See acceleration for the packages it may change. ONNX Runtime imports but has no CUDA provider The setup helper returns when ONNX and ONNX Runtime import successfully, even for a CPU-only runtime. Install an appropriate GPU runtime in the active environment and inspect the session/provider diagnostics. TensorRT execution provider missing The selected ONNX Runtime build must include TensorrtExecutionProvider ; installing the TensorRT Python package alone does not add a missing provider to ORT. TensorRT provider is listed but libnvinfer cannot load Install matching TensorRT libraries and make their directory visible before starting Python. Check the CUDA/driver/library combination. Use the working PyTorch route while resolving the optional backend. MegaPose first use spends a long time preparing files Setup can clone third_party_megapose6d/ , create a Python 3.9 environment under .envs/megapose/ , install its own stack, and fetch models. It requires conda, network access, writable storage, and available disk space. See MegaPose . MegaPose model config/checkpoint missing Keep the full upstream model layout, including config files; a checkpoint-only mirror may be incomplete. Review the downloader/rclone error emitted by the setup rather than copying an unrelated checkpoint. When reporting an error, include the command, script name, Python executable, backend, relevant file paths and the first exception in the log. For a MegaPose subprocess error, keep the full log so the traceback from that environment is available. WAPR inputs and download caches See Installation for WAPR packages, compilation and resources. This project uses separate estimate_from_masks calls. Check original-frame masks, registered meter depth, intrinsics and meter meshes first. Empty masks, missing positive depth and output count errors raise explicitly. Hugging Face offline fallback may return an existing directory. The assets recipe therefore checks seven exact file sizes and both weight digests. Follow Assets to redownload corrupt files. Inspect and move extra old checkpoints or notes out of best_score/ ; they are never automatically deleted. pnp_success=False means initial PnP failed. Do not treat a fallback identity transform as a reliable pose. Missing keypoints_ for the default combined PnP raises with the checkpoint path; first verify object and network compatibility.

title: RGB 图片推理
text: RGB 图片推理 HccePose(BF) 从彩色图像估计已知物体的位姿。检测器可以识别多种目标物体，同一类别也可有多个实例；位姿网络的权重按物体分别加载。先按 资源页 下载公开模型、检测器、位姿权重与输入帧，再运行 第一次预测 。 模型与输入文件 资源 用途 models/models_info.json 与 obj_000001.ply 模型坐标范围、直径和网格，采用 BOP 毫米约定。 yolo11/train_obj_s/detection/obj_s/yolo11-detection-obj_s.pt 多类别检测器，类别顺序需与模型编号表一致。 HccePose/obj_01/best_score/ 当前物体的位姿权重，保留原文件名。 test_imgs_RGBD/000003_rgb.png 公开的 640×400 输入帧；本页不需要深度图。 test_imgs_RGBD/000003_camera_matrix.json 按资源页从同帧校准文件生成的 3×3 内参。 只预测 [1] 并不减少初始化时需要加载的物体权重；模型表中的每个物体都要准备好资源。更换自己的物体时，需要匹配的检测器、位姿网络和模型元数据，不能只替换网格。 运行单图示例 将下面脚本保存在项目根目录。路径以脚本为锚点，从其他工作目录启动也指向同一套资源。 PYTHON import os import sys project_dir = os . path . dirname ( os . path . abspath ( __file__ )) sys . path . insert ( 0 , project_dir ) from examples.inference.predict_image import main if __name__ == '__main__' : data_root = os . path . join ( project_dir , 'data' ) results = main ( os . path . join ( data_root , 'demo-bin-picking' ), os . path . join ( data_root , 'test_imgs_RGBD' , '000003_rgb.png' ), os . path . join ( data_root , 'test_imgs_RGBD' , '000003_camera_matrix.json' ), [ 1 ], os . path . join ( project_dir , 'outputs' , 'rgb' ), ) 也可以编辑 examples/inference/predict_image.py 末尾的显式路径，再从项目根目录运行： BASH python examples/inference/predict_image.py main() 检查图像、内参和编号，初始化一次 Tester ，返回完整结果字典，并将生成的图像写入输出目录。重复处理很多图片时，使用 Tester 接口 在循环外初始化模型。 图像通道、坐标与有效位姿 OpenCV 的 cv2.imread 返回 BGR uint8 ，直接传入 predict 。输入内参必须与相机和图像分辨率匹配；缩放图像后也要同步缩放内参。 读取 results[obj_id]['pnp_success'] 判断初始位姿求解是否成功。 Rts 为物体到相机的变换，平移单位为毫米。 conf 来自 YOLO，不是位姿精度或 WAPR 评分。详细的掩码、坐标、logits 和变换形状见 结果字典 。 查看预测内容 下列图片来自公开上游的料箱抓取示例，仅用于解释输出形式。线框是按估计位姿投影的三维包围盒，不代表真值标签或场景中物体总数。 show_2D_results 展示检测框； show_6D_vis0 展示实例裁剪、掩码和编码； show_6D_vis1 、 show_6D_vis2 展示整图投影。画面可能拼接多个面板，不能把输出尺寸当成输入原图尺寸。 需要深度辅助估计时看 WAPR ，需要纯 RGB 或 RGB-D 精修时看 MegaPose ，连续帧处理见 视频教程 。

title: RGB image inference
text: RGB image inference HccePose(BF) estimates known-object poses from color images. The detector can recognize multiple target categories, each with multiple instances; pose checkpoints are loaded per object. Download the public models, detector, pose weights and input frame following Assets , then run Your first prediction . Models and input files Resource Purpose models/models_info.json and obj_000001.ply Model bounds, diameter and mesh in the BOP millimeter convention. yolo11/train_obj_s/detection/obj_s/yolo11-detection-obj_s.pt Multi-category detector; category order must match the model ID table. HccePose/obj_01/best_score/ Per-object pose weights, retaining their original filenames. test_imgs_RGBD/000003_rgb.png Public 640×400 input frame; this page does not require depth. test_imgs_RGBD/000003_camera_matrix.json The 3×3 matrix derived from that frame’s calibration on the assets page. Predicting only [1] does not reduce the checkpoints loaded during initialization. Prepare resources for every object in the model table. A new object needs a matching detector, pose network and model metadata; replacing only the mesh is insufficient. Run a single image Save this script in the project root. Paths are anchored to the script, so launching from another working directory selects the same resources. PYTHON import os import sys project_dir = os . path . dirname ( os . path . abspath ( __file__ )) sys . path . insert ( 0 , project_dir ) from examples.inference.predict_image import main if __name__ == '__main__' : data_root = os . path . join ( project_dir , 'data' ) results = main ( os . path . join ( data_root , 'demo-bin-picking' ), os . path . join ( data_root , 'test_imgs_RGBD' , '000003_rgb.png' ), os . path . join ( data_root , 'test_imgs_RGBD' , '000003_camera_matrix.json' ), [ 1 ], os . path . join ( project_dir , 'outputs' , 'rgb' ), ) Alternatively, edit the explicit paths at the end of examples/inference/predict_image.py and run it from the project root: BASH python examples/inference/predict_image.py main() checks the image, intrinsics and object IDs, initializes one Tester , returns its full result dictionary, and saves available images in the output directory. For many images, initialize the model outside the loop using the Tester API . Channels, coordinates and valid poses OpenCV cv2.imread returns BGR uint8 ; pass it directly to predict . Intrinsics must match the camera and image dimensions. Resize the intrinsics together with any image resizing. Check results[obj_id]['pnp_success'] for initial pose-solving success. Rts transforms object coordinates to camera coordinates with millimeter translations. conf is the YOLO score, not pose accuracy or a WAPR score. See the result dictionary for mask, coordinate, logit and transform shapes. Inspect the predictions The images below are from the public upstream bin-picking example and illustrate output formats. Wireframes are 3D bounding boxes projected using estimated poses; they are not ground-truth labels or a count of all objects in the scene. show_2D_results displays detections; show_6D_vis0 displays instance crops, masks and codes; show_6D_vis1 and show_6D_vis2 show full-scene projections. Images may contain several panels, so output dimensions are not interchangeable with original input dimensions. See WAPR for depth-assisted estimation, MegaPose for RGB or RGB-D refinement, and video inference for continuous frames.

title: 视频推理
text: 视频推理 视频中的每一帧独立检测物体、预测表面坐标并求解位姿。模型只加载一次，各帧之间不传递位姿和跟踪状态。先用 RGB 单图 确认模型可用，再处理视频。 视频、权重与相机 公开测试视频位于 Hugging Face 的 test_videos 。物体模型和权重的目录要求与单图一致。视频可能包含多个目标物体，应加载相应编号表中的全部模型。 下面脚本的 input.mp4 和 video_camera_matrix.json 是用户需要准备的文件。相机 JSON 应为该视频分辨率对应的 3×3 数组；不要直接套用另一相机或另一帧的内参。将脚本保存在项目根目录。 逐帧推理与保存 PYTHON import json import os import sys project_dir = os . path . dirname ( os . path . abspath ( __file__ )) sys . path . insert ( 0 , project_dir ) import cv2 import numpy as np from HccePose.bop_loader import bop_dataset from HccePose.tester import Tester if __name__ == '__main__' : data_root = os . path . join ( project_dir , 'data' ) dataset_root = os . path . join ( data_root , 'demo-bin-picking' ) video_path = os . path . join ( data_root , 'test_videos' , 'input.mp4' ) camera_path = os . path . join ( data_root , 'video_camera_matrix.json' ) output_path = os . path . join ( project_dir , 'outputs' , 'video' , 'poses.mp4' ) object_ids = [ 1 ] with open ( camera_path , encoding = 'utf-8' ) as handle : cam_K = np . asarray ( json . load ( handle ), dtype = np . float32 ) dataset = bop_dataset ( dataset_root ) tester = Tester ( dataset , CUDA_DEVICE = '0' , hccepose_vis = True ) capture = cv2 . VideoCapture ( video_path ) if not capture . isOpened (): raise OSError ( video_path ) fps = capture . get ( cv2 . CAP_PROP_FPS ) if not np . isfinite ( fps ) or fps <= 0 : capture . release () raise ValueError ( 'Invalid source frame rate' ) os . makedirs ( os . path . dirname ( output_path ), exist_ok = True ) writer = None try : while True : ok , image_bgr = capture . read () if not ok : break results = tester . predict ( cam_K , image_bgr , object_ids ) canvas = results [ 'show_6D_vis1' ] height , width = canvas . shape [: 2 ] if writer is None : output_size = ( width , height ) writer = cv2 . VideoWriter ( output_path , cv2 . VideoWriter_fourcc ( * 'mp4v' ), fps , output_size ) if not writer . isOpened (): raise OSError ( output_path ) if ( width , height ) != output_size : raise ValueError ( 'Visualization size changed within the video' ) writer . write ( canvas ) finally : capture . release () if writer is not None : writer . release () 模型在循环外创建。 VideoCapture 返回 BGR 帧，可直接传给 predict 。写入器根据第一帧实际拼图尺寸创建，并检查后续尺寸不变；视频输出编码可按浏览器和系统支持另行转换。 如果视频分辨率改变，先同步更新内参。模型内部的缩放补边由 Tester 处理，不要额外用输出画布尺寸替换原图内参。需要逐实例结果时，读取每帧结果中的整数物体键与 pnp_success ，见 结果字典 。 理解播放帧率与运行速度 输出视频沿用输入 FPS，表示回放时的时间尺度，不代表模型能以该速度在线处理。 results['time'] 不含模型加载、视频读取和写入，实际整段耗时还应包括这些操作。阶段计时见 工具接口 。 公开示例预览 下面按“输入视频 → 对应预测”的顺序展示料箱和纹理物体两个场景，方便对照输入及输出中的物体区域。视频均由同一公开源码版本的动图转换为 H.264，保留完整画面和原始比例，静音自动循环；不是另行采集的数据。 预测预览显示掩码、位姿、前后表面坐标与 C1–C6 六层编码，用于展示预测形式，不是本机速度测量。 料箱输入 料箱预测 纹理物体输入 纹理物体预测 公开原始脚本： 料箱视频 · 纹理物体视频 。这些脚本位于上游根目录，输入路径和标定需按实际视频设置。

title: Video inference
text: Video inference Each frame is processed independently: detect objects, predict surface coordinates, and solve poses. Models are loaded once; no pose or tracking state passes between frames. First confirm the model with an RGB image , then process video. Video, weights and camera Public input videos are available under test_videos on Hugging Face . Model and checkpoint layouts match image inference. Videos may contain multiple target categories; prepare every model listed in the corresponding ID table. The script below expects caller-supplied input.mp4 and video_camera_matrix.json . The latter must be a 3×3 array calibrated for the video’s resolution. Do not reuse intrinsics from another camera or unrelated frame. Save the script in the project root. Predict and save frames PYTHON import json import os import sys project_dir = os . path . dirname ( os . path . abspath ( __file__ )) sys . path . insert ( 0 , project_dir ) import cv2 import numpy as np from HccePose.bop_loader import bop_dataset from HccePose.tester import Tester if __name__ == '__main__' : data_root = os . path . join ( project_dir , 'data' ) dataset_root = os . path . join ( data_root , 'demo-bin-picking' ) video_path = os . path . join ( data_root , 'test_videos' , 'input.mp4' ) camera_path = os . path . join ( data_root , 'video_camera_matrix.json' ) output_path = os . path . join ( project_dir , 'outputs' , 'video' , 'poses.mp4' ) object_ids = [ 1 ] with open ( camera_path , encoding = 'utf-8' ) as handle : cam_K = np . asarray ( json . load ( handle ), dtype = np . float32 ) dataset = bop_dataset ( dataset_root ) tester = Tester ( dataset , CUDA_DEVICE = '0' , hccepose_vis = True ) capture = cv2 . VideoCapture ( video_path ) if not capture . isOpened (): raise OSError ( video_path ) fps = capture . get ( cv2 . CAP_PROP_FPS ) if not np . isfinite ( fps ) or fps <= 0 : capture . release () raise ValueError ( 'Invalid source frame rate' ) os . makedirs ( os . path . dirname ( output_path ), exist_ok = True ) writer = None try : while True : ok , image_bgr = capture . read () if not ok : break results = tester . predict ( cam_K , image_bgr , object_ids ) canvas = results [ 'show_6D_vis1' ] height , width = canvas . shape [: 2 ] if writer is None : output_size = ( width , height ) writer = cv2 . VideoWriter ( output_path , cv2 . VideoWriter_fourcc ( * 'mp4v' ), fps , output_size ) if not writer . isOpened (): raise OSError ( output_path ) if ( width , height ) != output_size : raise ValueError ( 'Visualization size changed within the video' ) writer . write ( canvas ) finally : capture . release () if writer is not None : writer . release () Models are constructed outside the loop. VideoCapture produces BGR frames suitable for predict . The writer uses the first actual visualization size and checks that subsequent dimensions remain stable. Convert the output codec separately if needed for your browser or system. Update intrinsics whenever video resolution changes. Tester handles its internal resizing and padding; do not replace original-image intrinsics using output-canvas dimensions. For instance results, read each frame’s integer object keys and pnp_success ; see results . Playback rate and processing speed The output retains source FPS for playback timing. This does not imply online inference at that speed. results['time'] excludes model loading, video decoding and writing; whole-video runtime includes those operations. See timing utilities . Public preview Each scene below shows its input video followed by the corresponding predictions, first for bin picking and then for textured objects. All videos are converted from animations in the same public source revision to browser-friendly H.264. They preserve complete frames and original aspect ratios and loop automatically without sound; no additional data was captured. Prediction previews show masks, poses, front/back surface coordinates and C1–C6 code levels. They illustrate predictions rather than measuring this machine’s speed. Bin-picking input Bin-picking predictions Textured-object input Textured-object predictions Public source recipes: bin-picking video · textured-object video . These scripts live in the upstream root; set their paths and calibration for the actual video.

title: WAPR 接入
text: WAPR 接入 掩码与深度，进入三维估计 WAPR 需 单独安装 。本接入依据 WAPR 公开版本 ，将 HccePose 从当前图像预测的实例掩码映射回原图，再调用 estimate_many_categories_many_instances 。该入口从区域估计位姿，不接收 HccePose 位姿初值。 接入函数将 BGR 彩色图转为 RGB，再将配准深度、内参和实例信息传入 WAPR。 三角块 RGB-D 示例 下面展示三角块场景的输入、位姿投影，以及对应的实测深度点云和 CAD 网格。示例包含已保存的 16 条位姿与评分记录，可查看其中保留的 7 条，也可检查低分及重复项。评分不是真值对错或物体存在概率。 右图仅显示七个保留实例，不同颜色用于区分实例，编号沿用原评分排名。 RGB 与三维联动查看 点击原图中的框、下方条目或三维网格，两侧会同步高亮。在画布上方选“平移”后拖动彩色坐标轴，选“旋转”后拖动带刻度的旋转环，滚轮缩放。“自由查看”支持拖动旋转、右键或 Shift 拖动平移；点击“对齐原图”恢复标定视角。手机可单指拖动操作轴或刻度环，双指缩放；“自由查看”支持单指旋转和双指平移/缩放。拖轴或环时加入第二指，会结束单指操作并转为双指查看。这些操作仅调整右侧展示，原图投影、保存的位姿和评分保持不变。白色散点表示观测深度，绿色、红色和橙色表面分别表示保留、低分和重复位姿，金色轮廓标记当前选中项。 此页面读取已保存的图像、点云、位姿和评分，在浏览器中完成展示，不执行模型推理。完整场景可切换“全部已评分”“保留”和“仅看选中项”；“保留”模式下，低分和重复项的按钮不可选。深度点云与 CAD 网格可独立开关；开启 CAD 网格后，可切换“CAD 线框模式”。 逐区域评分对照 每格左侧是原图裁剪，右侧是该位姿的投影，分数和筛选状态直接标在图上。拼图按四行四列紧凑排列，窄屏可横向查看，也可点击放大。绿色表示保留，橙色表示重复，红色表示低分；去重后的条目沿用原排名。 示例场景的评分是已保存的展示记录。运行下面的接口会根据新的输入生成结果，不会自动改写网页场景，也不保证与本例具有相同的检测数量或分数。 若需要分数门槛与 CAD 渲染掩码 NMS，参见 评分筛选与 NMS 。独立脚本保留原始输出，并调用 WAPR 公开的去重函数。 输入与运行 准备 BGR 图像、配准深度、原图内参、米制物体网格与直径。示例从公开 BOP 毫米模型显式转换为米。 编辑 examples/inference/predict_wapr.py 的路径、物体编号和深度单位换算，再运行： BASH python examples/inference/predict_wapr.py 使用 资源页下载的示例 时，也可从项目根目录调用： PYTHON from examples.inference.predict_wapr import main # 此帧的原始深度单位为毫米；自有数据需核对传感器单位。 records = main ( "data/demo-bin-picking" , "data/test_imgs_RGBD/000003_rgb.png" , "data/test_imgs_RGBD/000003_depth.png" , "data/test_imgs_RGBD/000003_camera_matrix.json" , [ 1 ], "outputs/wapr.json" , depth_scale_to_m = 1e-3 ) 输出 outputs/wapr.json 保留输入实例顺序，含物体编号、实例索引、 pose_4x4_m （物体到相机，平移单位为米）及针对本次输入计算的 score_6d 。评分并非概率，也不等于目标确认；应用应根据自身需求定义接收、去重和排序策略。 物体编号必须出现在本数据集的 models_info.json 中，每个编号只填一次。若同一物体类别在图中出现多次，脚本会为每个检测实例分别输出记录；若所有请求的类别都未检出，输出为 [] 。每张裁剪掩码须对应一个变换矩阵。数量不匹配、掩码为空或掩码区域内没有正深度时，调用会报错。 多物体、多实例与掩码顺序 object_ids 选择物体类别；同一个编号只列一次，由检测结果产生该类的全部实例。入口会按物体组和组内实例顺序还原掩码，为每项准备对应的米制网格及直径，再调用公开的批量估计接口。输出中的 object_id 和 instance_index 用于追溯输入。 多个区域不等于多个真实物体。检测器可能漏检、重复检测或包含背景区域，WAPR 返回可计算的位姿与分数也不等于确认目标。需要保留原始结果与各实例标识，再按应用规则检查、去重及排序，不能根据展示数量推断查全率。 在自己的 Python 程序中接入 PYTHON from Refinement.wapr_public import restore_full_frame_masks , estimate_from_masks # predictions 来自当前帧；不同物体使用各自的 mesh 与 diameter_m。 masks = restore_full_frame_masks ( predictions [ obj_id ], image_bgr . shape ) instances = [{ 'mesh' : mesh , 'diameter_m' : diameter_m , 'mask' : mask } for mask in masks ] results_wapr = estimate_from_masks ( estimator , image_bgr , depth_m , cam_K , instances ) 上例中的网格顶点、直径和深度都必须已经转换为米； estimator 是按公开安装说明初始化的 WAPR 对象。入口只估计给定掩码，不需要把 HccePose 的 PnP 初值传入。完整输入检查、原图还原和直接使用外部掩码的方法见 精修接口 。 结果文件与异常 字段 含义 object_id BOP 物体编号。 instance_index 该物体预测结果中的组内行号。 pose_4x4_m 物体到相机的齐次变换，平移为米。 score_6d WAPR 针对本次图像、深度和掩码计算的评分。 JSON 不保存固定实验分数，不使用真值标签生成评分。资源缺失、内参格式错误、重复或未知编号在模型加载前报错；形状不符、非有限深度、没有有效深度的掩码和无效输出不会被当作成功结果。读取和单位转换见 结果字典 。 多帧应用可复用 Tester 和 WAPR 估计器。文件入口便于首次接入，重复调用它会重复初始化模型；高频处理应参考 接口教程 组织循环。首次运行所需资源准备与实际推理需分开计时。

title: WAPR integration
text: WAPR integration From masks and depth to 3D estimation Install WAPR separately . This adapter targets the published WAPR version . It restores instance masks predicted by HccePose for the current image to the full frame and calls estimate_many_categories_many_instances . This entry estimates poses from regions; it does not accept HccePose pose seeds. The adapter converts the BGR image to RGB and passes it to WAPR with registered depth, intrinsics and instance data. Triangular-part RGB-D example The example below pairs the triangular-part input with pose projections, measured depth points and CAD meshes. It contains 16 saved pose/score records, including 7 accepted entries; low-scoring and duplicate entries remain inspectable. Scores do not indicate ground-truth correctness or object-presence probability. The right image shows only the seven accepted instances. Different colors distinguish instances, and the labels retain their original score ranks. Linked RGB and 3D inspection Select an image box, an entry below, or a 3D mesh to highlight it in both views. Choose Pan above the canvases and drag a colored axis, or Rotate and drag a graduated ring; scroll to zoom. Orbit retains drag-to-rotate and right/Shift-drag-to-pan. “Align with RGB” restores the calibrated view. On touchscreens, drag axes or rings with one finger and pinch to zoom; Orbit supports one-finger rotation and two-finger pan/zoom. Adding a second finger ends a handle drag and switches to two-finger navigation. These controls adjust only the 3D display; image projections, saved poses and scores remain unchanged. White points represent observed depth; green, red and amber surfaces indicate accepted, low-scoring and duplicate poses. A gold outline marks the selected mesh. The viewer loads saved images, points, poses and scores; it does not run model inference. Switch among all scored entries, accepted entries and the selected entry; buttons for low-scoring and duplicate entries are disabled in accepted mode. Depth points and CAD meshes can be toggled independently. With CAD meshes enabled, use “CAD wireframe mode” to display them as wireframes. Per-region score comparison Each tile pairs an original crop on the left with its pose projection on the right. Scores and selection states are drawn directly on the image. The compact four-by-four montage supports horizontal scrolling on narrow screens and click-to-enlarge. Green denotes accepted entries, amber duplicates and red low scores. Retained entries keep their original ranks. Scores in this scene are saved display records. Running the interface below computes results for new input; it neither rewrites the website scene automatically nor guarantees the same detection counts or scores. For an optional score gate and CAD rendered-mask NMS, follow score filtering and NMS . The separate script preserves raw output and calls the published WAPR suppression function. Inputs and execution Prepare a BGR image, registered depth, original-image intrinsics, meter meshes and meter diameters. The example explicitly converts published BOP millimeter models to meters. Edit the paths, object IDs and depth conversion in examples/inference/predict_wapr.py , then run: BASH python examples/inference/predict_wapr.py For the example downloaded on the resource page , you can also call this from the project root: PYTHON from examples.inference.predict_wapr import main # This frame stores raw depth in millimeters; check sensor units for your own data. records = main ( "data/demo-bin-picking" , "data/test_imgs_RGBD/000003_rgb.png" , "data/test_imgs_RGBD/000003_depth.png" , "data/test_imgs_RGBD/000003_camera_matrix.json" , [ 1 ], "outputs/wapr.json" , depth_scale_to_m = 1e-3 ) outputs/wapr.json preserves input instance order and contains object IDs, instance indices, pose_4x4_m (object to camera, translation in meters), and score_6d computed for the current input. A score is not a probability or object confirmation; define acceptance, deduplication and ranking policies for your application. Request each object ID once and use IDs listed in the dataset’s models_info.json . Multiple detections of the same category produce separate records. If none of the requested objects is detected, the output is [] . Each crop mask needs its own transform. A count mismatch, an empty mask, or a mask with no positive depth raises an error. Multiple objects, instances and mask order object_ids selects categories; list each ID once. Detections produce all instances for that category. The entry point restores masks in object-group and within-group order, prepares the matching meter mesh and diameter for each entry, then calls the public batch API. Output object_id and instance_index retain the input association. Multiple regions do not necessarily represent distinct physical objects. Detections may miss targets, duplicate them or include background. A computable WAPR pose and score do not confirm object presence. Preserve raw results and instance identities, then check, suppress and rank according to application rules. Display count does not measure recall. Integrate into your Python application PYTHON from Refinement.wapr_public import restore_full_frame_masks , estimate_from_masks # predictions belongs to this frame; supply each object's own mesh and diameter_m. masks = restore_full_frame_masks ( predictions [ obj_id ], image_bgr . shape ) instances = [{ 'mesh' : mesh , 'diameter_m' : diameter_m , 'mask' : mask } for mask in masks ] results_wapr = estimate_from_masks ( estimator , image_bgr , depth_m , cam_K , instances ) Mesh vertices, diameter and depth must already be in meters. estimator is a WAPR object initialized following the public installation guide. This entry point estimates from the supplied masks without HccePose PnP seeds. See the refinement API for input checks, full-frame restoration and independently supplied masks. Output file and errors Field Meaning object_id BOP object ID. instance_index Row within that object’s prediction group. pose_4x4_m Object-to-camera homogeneous transform with meter translation. score_6d WAPR score computed from this image, depth and mask. The JSON contains no fixed experimental scores and uses no ground-truth labels to generate them. Missing resources, invalid intrinsics and duplicate or unknown IDs raise before model loading. Shape mismatches, nonfinite depth, masks without valid depth and invalid outputs are not treated as successes. See results for reading and unit conversions. Multi-frame applications can reuse Tester and the WAPR estimator. The file entry point is convenient initially but reinitializes models on repeated calls; organize high-frequency loops using the API tutorial . Separate first-time resource preparation from inference timing.

title: WAPR 评分筛选与 NMS
text: WAPR 评分筛选与渲染掩码 NMS WAPR 推理示例 会保存各实例的估计位姿与评分。本教程提供可选的第二步：先按分数筛选，再调用 固定公开版 WAPR 的 NMS 实现 ，移除投影高度重叠的位姿。不改变原适配器，也不重新运行位姿网络。 准备同一帧与模型 先运行 examples/inference/predict_wapr.py ，保留其输出 outputs/wapr.json 。后处理时使用同一张图像、原图内参和对应物体网格。每条记录须含 object_id 、 instance_index 、 pose_4x4_m 与 score_6d 。 脚本从 <dataset_root>/models/obj_XXXXXX.ply 读取 BOP 网格。BOP 顶点使用毫米， mesh_scale_to_m=1e-3 将其换算为米；如果网格已经以米表示，将其设为 1 。网格坐标与保存位姿须使用同一个原始物体坐标系，之后不要再将网格居中。 分数筛选在 CPU 上执行。有记录通过门槛时，渲染掩码 NMS 需要 已安装 WAPR 的 CUDA 渲染器，并使用同一 Python 环境。脚本不会重新加载位姿网络权重。缺少网格或渲染器出错时会报错，不会悄悄退回未筛选结果。 脚本可在公开源码中查看： postprocess_wapr.py 。 运行可选脚本 examples/inference/postprocess_wapr.py 底部的可编辑参数对应 资源页下载的 RGB-D 示例 。核对路径后，从项目根目录运行： BASH python examples/inference/postprocess_wapr.py 原始 JSON 保持不变，结果单独写入 outputs/wapr_filtered.json 。在 Python 应用中也可调用： PYTHON from examples.inference.postprocess_wapr import main # 路径与位姿必须对应同一帧。 report = main ( "data/demo-bin-picking" , "data/test_imgs_RGBD/000003_rgb.png" , "data/test_imgs_RGBD/000003_camera_matrix.json" , "outputs/wapr.json" , "outputs/wapr_filtered.json" , score_threshold = 0.75 , nms_iou_threshold = 0.5 , device = "cuda:0" , mesh_scale_to_m = 1e-3 , ) retained = report [ "retained_records" ] 对于内存中的记录，也可调用 filter_records(records, meshes_by_id, cam_K, image.shape, score_threshold, nms_iou_threshold, device) 。其中 meshes_by_id 将每个通过评分的 BOP 物体编号映射到其米制网格；记录格式与 predict_wapr.py 一致。 两个不同的阈值 参数 示例值 行为 score_threshold 0.75 对返回的 score_6d 应用 WBPS 门槛，NMS 前先保留 score_6d >= 0.75 的记录。这是应用参数，不是对所有物体都校准过的概率门槛；大于 1 的评分原样保留。 nms_iou_threshold 0.5 仅在同一 object_id 内优先考虑高分位姿；渲染掩码 IoU 严格大于 0.5 时抑制排序靠后的位姿，等于门槛时保留。 IoU 示例值沿用 公开 WAPR 示例 。两个值都作为脚本中的应用参数显式保留，不改变 WAPR 的科学默认值。应根据物体和相机调整。 NMS 比较什么 对每个通过评分的位姿，WAPR 使用对应 CAD、估计的物体到相机变换及原图内参渲染物体剪影。NMS 比较的是这些随位姿变化的掩码，不只是原检测框或输入掩码。不同物体编号使用各自的网格，分组处理。 公开贪心实现对同分项优先保留输入较早的记录；被抑制项不会继续抑制后续项。输出沿用原输入顺序，不按分数重新排序。投影掩码为空的结果也会被后端移除。 高度重叠的投影也可能来自不同真实物体，遮挡或深度不同的场景尤其如此。剪影 IoU 本身不能确认物理身份或六维位姿精度；应检查这类情况，再按应用调整策略。本示例没有另外加入平移、旋转距离判据，也不进行跨类别抑制。 读取输出 字段 含义 raw_records 所有输入记录，保留原评分与实例标识。 decisions 逐输入的 input_index 、物体与实例标识、评分和筛选状态。 kept_input_indices 指向原列表的下标，保持输入顺序。 retained_records 通过分数门槛且在渲染掩码 NMS 后保留的记录。 score_threshold 、 nms_iou_threshold 、 nms_method 本次输出采用的策略。 筛选状态为 kept 、 below_score_threshold 或 not_retained_by_mask_nms 。最后一种同时包含空投影和重叠抑制，不能直接解释为已确认的重复物体。跳过项不会被伪造为零分。 与网站演示的关系 三角块查看器展示的是已保存结果。本脚本根据传入的 JSON 和模型计算筛选结果，不改写查看器，保留数量由当前输入和阈值决定。通过评分或 NMS 也不等于真值确认；比较策略时请保留原始文件。

title: WAPR score filtering and NMS
text: WAPR score filtering and rendered-mask NMS The WAPR inference example saves every estimated pose and score. This optional second step applies a score gate, then removes overlapping pose projections with the fixed public WAPR NMS implementation . It does not change the adapter or rerun the pose networks. Prepare the same frame and models First run examples/inference/predict_wapr.py and keep its outputs/wapr.json . Supply the same image, original-image intrinsics and object meshes when postprocessing. The JSON must contain object_id , instance_index , pose_4x4_m and score_6d for each input instance. The script reads BOP meshes from <dataset_root>/models/obj_XXXXXX.ply . BOP vertices use millimeters, so mesh_scale_to_m=1e-3 converts them to meters. Set it to 1 for meshes already in meters. Mesh coordinates and the saved pose must refer to the same original object frame; do not recenter the mesh afterward. The score gate runs on CPU. When any record passes it, rendered-mask NMS requires the CUDA renderer from the WAPR installation , in the same Python environment. No pose-network weights are loaded again by this script. Missing meshes or renderer failures raise errors rather than silently returning an unfiltered list. The script is available in the public source: postprocess_wapr.py . Run the optional script The editable values at the bottom of examples/inference/postprocess_wapr.py use the downloaded RGB-D example . Check the paths, then run from the project root: BASH python examples/inference/postprocess_wapr.py The raw JSON remains unchanged. The result is written separately to outputs/wapr_filtered.json . For Python applications: PYTHON from examples.inference.postprocess_wapr import main # These paths and poses must belong to the same frame. report = main ( "data/demo-bin-picking" , "data/test_imgs_RGBD/000003_rgb.png" , "data/test_imgs_RGBD/000003_camera_matrix.json" , "outputs/wapr.json" , "outputs/wapr_filtered.json" , score_threshold = 0.75 , nms_iou_threshold = 0.5 , device = "cuda:0" , mesh_scale_to_m = 1e-3 , ) retained = report [ "retained_records" ] You can also call filter_records(records, meshes_by_id, cam_K, image.shape, score_threshold, nms_iou_threshold, device) on in-memory records. meshes_by_id maps each qualifying BOP object ID to its meter mesh. Records keep the same schema as predict_wapr.py . Two different thresholds Parameter Example value Behavior score_threshold 0.75 Apply the WBPS score gate to the returned score_6d : keep score_6d >= 0.75 before NMS. This is an application choice, not a probability cutoff calibrated for every object. Scores above 1 are preserved. nms_iou_threshold 0.5 Within the same object_id , consider higher scores first and suppress a lower-ranked pose when rendered-mask IoU is strictly greater than 0.5. Equality is kept. The IoU value follows the public WAPR example . Both values are visible script variables for the application; they do not change WAPR's scientific defaults. Tune them for your objects and camera. What the NMS compares For each score-qualified pose, WAPR renders that object's CAD silhouette using its estimated object-to-camera transform and the original image intrinsics. NMS compares these pose-dependent masks, not just the original detector boxes or input masks. Different object IDs use their own meshes and are processed separately. The public greedy implementation gives earlier input rows priority when scores tie. A suppressed row does not suppress later rows. Output records preserve their original input order rather than being reordered by score. Empty projected masks are also removed by the backend. Highly overlapping projections can belong to distinct objects, particularly under occlusion or at different depths. Silhouette IoU alone does not establish physical identity or 6D accuracy; inspect such cases and adjust the policy for your application. This example does not add a separate translation/rotation-distance test or cross-category suppression. Read the output Key Meaning raw_records All input records, including their original scores and instance identities. decisions Per-input input_index , object/instance identity, score and selection status. kept_input_indices Indices into the raw list, in input order. retained_records Records that passed the score gate and survived rendered-mask NMS. score_threshold , nms_iou_threshold , nms_method The policy used for this output. A decision has status kept , below_score_threshold or not_retained_by_mask_nms . The last status includes empty projections as well as overlap suppression, so it is not automatically a confirmed duplicate. No skipped item is assigned a fake zero score. Relation to the website example The triangular-part viewer displays saved results. This script computes selection from the supplied JSON and models; it does not rewrite the viewer. The retained count depends on the current inputs and thresholds. Passing a score gate or NMS is also not ground-truth confirmation. Keep the raw file when comparing policies.

title: MegaPose 位姿精修
text: MegaPose 位姿精修 MegaPose 从 HccePose 的初始位姿继续精修。RGB 模型只需彩色图像，RGB-D 模型还使用配准的米制深度图。两者都需要目标物体网格和相机内参。 环境与模型选择 首次注册可能克隆公开 MegaPose、在 .envs/megapose/ 创建 Python 3.9 子环境并下载依赖与模型。需要网络、可写目录和 Conda。主项目 Python 环境与 MegaPose 子环境分开，设置见 安装说明 。 PYTHON tester . register_megapose ( megapose_model_name_rgb = 'megapose-1.0-RGB-multi-hypothesis' , megapose_model_name_rgbd = 'megapose-1.0-RGBD' , ) 也可首次 predict(..., use_megapose=True) 时自动注册。为多帧复用同一个 Tester ，避免反复初始化。 同一帧使用 RGB 或 RGB-D 准备 资源页 的公开帧并生成相机矩阵，将以下脚本保存于项目根目录。 use_depth=True 读取深度，设为 False 时不读取深度文件、直接使用 RGB 模型。 PYTHON import json import os import sys project_dir = os . path . dirname ( os . path . abspath ( __file__ )) sys . path . insert ( 0 , project_dir ) import cv2 import numpy as np from HccePose.bop_loader import bop_dataset from HccePose.tester import Tester from HccePose.test_script_utils import save_visual_artifacts if __name__ == '__main__' : data_root = os . path . join ( project_dir , 'data' ) capture_dir = os . path . join ( data_root , 'test_imgs_RGBD' ) dataset = bop_dataset ( os . path . join ( data_root , 'demo-bin-picking' )) image_bgr = cv2 . imread ( os . path . join ( capture_dir , '000003_rgb.png' )) with open ( os . path . join ( capture_dir , '000003_camera_matrix.json' ), encoding = 'utf-8' ) as handle : cam_K = np . asarray ( json . load ( handle ), dtype = np . float32 ) use_depth = True depth_m = None if use_depth : depth_raw = cv2 . imread ( os . path . join ( capture_dir , '000003_depth.png' ), cv2 . IMREAD_UNCHANGED ) if depth_raw is None or image_bgr is None or depth_raw . shape != image_bgr . shape [: 2 ]: raise ValueError ( 'Expected aligned RGB and depth' ) depth_m = depth_raw . astype ( np . float32 ) * 1e-3 if image_bgr is None : raise ValueError ( 'Cannot decode RGB image' ) tester = Tester ( dataset , CUDA_DEVICE = '0' , hccepose_vis = True ) results = tester . predict ( cam_K , image_bgr , [ 1 ], depth = depth_m , use_megapose = True , megapose_vis = True ) output_dir = os . path . join ( project_dir , 'outputs' , 'megapose' ) save_visual_artifacts ([ ( os . path . join ( output_dir , 'poses.jpg' ), results . get ( 'show_6D_vis1' )), ( os . path . join ( output_dir , 'refinement.jpg' ), results . get ( 'show_megapose' )), ]) 毫米深度到米的系数仅适用于这个公开帧。自己的传感器应明确单位并完成彩色/深度配准。只用 RGB 时直接传 depth=None ，不需要虚构深度图。 输出与实例对应 精修前的毫米位姿保存在 Rts_hccepose ； Rts 中成功的实例更新为 MegaPose 结果。 megapose_valid_pose_ids 是原实例行号，分数与该数组对齐。没有更新的行保留初值，因此不能把“有返回位姿”直接解释为“精修成功”。 conf 仍是检测分数， pnp_success 仍记录初始 PnP。 调试图可通过 megapose_vis=True 获取； megapose_vis_stages 选择中间阶段。输出 BGR 图像适合 OpenCV 保存，详见 结果字典 与 工具接口 。 公开示例图 以下图像来自公开上游的同一帧示例，分别展示 RGB-D 和 RGB 模型的输出，不是新的性能或精度测量。 源码与模型使用条件见 MegaPose 。比较方法与单位换算见 RGB-D 对比 。

title: MegaPose refinement
text: MegaPose refinement MegaPose refines HccePose’s initial poses. Its RGB model uses color only; its RGB-D model additionally uses registered depth in meters. Both need object meshes and camera intrinsics. Environment and model selection First registration may clone public MegaPose, create a Python 3.9 environment under .envs/megapose/ , and download dependencies and models. It requires networking, writable directories and Conda. MegaPose runs separately from the main Python environment; see Installation . PYTHON tester . register_megapose ( megapose_model_name_rgb = 'megapose-1.0-RGB-multi-hypothesis' , megapose_model_name_rgbd = 'megapose-1.0-RGBD' , ) Registration can also happen on the first predict(..., use_megapose=True) call. Reuse one Tester across frames to avoid repeated initialization. RGB or RGB-D on the same frame Prepare the public frame and derived camera matrix from Assets , then save this script in the project root. use_depth=True loads depth. Setting it to False selects RGB without reading a depth file. PYTHON import json import os import sys project_dir = os . path . dirname ( os . path . abspath ( __file__ )) sys . path . insert ( 0 , project_dir ) import cv2 import numpy as np from HccePose.bop_loader import bop_dataset from HccePose.tester import Tester from HccePose.test_script_utils import save_visual_artifacts if __name__ == '__main__' : data_root = os . path . join ( project_dir , 'data' ) capture_dir = os . path . join ( data_root , 'test_imgs_RGBD' ) dataset = bop_dataset ( os . path . join ( data_root , 'demo-bin-picking' )) image_bgr = cv2 . imread ( os . path . join ( capture_dir , '000003_rgb.png' )) with open ( os . path . join ( capture_dir , '000003_camera_matrix.json' ), encoding = 'utf-8' ) as handle : cam_K = np . asarray ( json . load ( handle ), dtype = np . float32 ) use_depth = True depth_m = None if use_depth : depth_raw = cv2 . imread ( os . path . join ( capture_dir , '000003_depth.png' ), cv2 . IMREAD_UNCHANGED ) if depth_raw is None or image_bgr is None or depth_raw . shape != image_bgr . shape [: 2 ]: raise ValueError ( 'Expected aligned RGB and depth' ) depth_m = depth_raw . astype ( np . float32 ) * 1e-3 if image_bgr is None : raise ValueError ( 'Cannot decode RGB image' ) tester = Tester ( dataset , CUDA_DEVICE = '0' , hccepose_vis = True ) results = tester . predict ( cam_K , image_bgr , [ 1 ], depth = depth_m , use_megapose = True , megapose_vis = True ) output_dir = os . path . join ( project_dir , 'outputs' , 'megapose' ) save_visual_artifacts ([ ( os . path . join ( output_dir , 'poses.jpg' ), results . get ( 'show_6D_vis1' )), ( os . path . join ( output_dir , 'refinement.jpg' ), results . get ( 'show_megapose' )), ]) The millimeter-to-meter conversion applies to this public frame. Check your own sensor units and register depth to color before use. For RGB only, pass depth=None without creating dummy depth. Outputs and instance alignment Rts_hccepose retains the initial millimeter poses. Successful refinements update rows in Rts . megapose_valid_pose_ids contains original instance indices, and scores align with that array. Unchanged rows retain the initial pose, so a returned pose alone does not demonstrate successful refinement. conf remains the detection score; pnp_success describes initial PnP. Request debug images with megapose_vis=True ; megapose_vis_stages selects intermediate stages. Images are BGR for OpenCV saving. See results and utilities . Public example images These public upstream images show the RGB-D and RGB models on the same frame. They are not new performance or accuracy measurements. See MegaPose for code and model terms. See RGB-D comparison for comparison procedures and unit conversions.

title: 位姿精修与深度对比
text: 位姿精修与深度对比 RGB、MegaPose RGB-D 与 WAPR 的结果应在同一套图像、模型、相机与单位约定下比较。先跑通 RGB 、 MegaPose 和 WAPR 各自教程，再保存对应输出。 同一帧，分别保存各分支 PYTHON # tester、image_bgr、cam_K 和米制 depth_m 已按前面的教程准备。 rgb_results = tester . predict ( cam_K , image_bgr , [ 1 ]) megapose_results = tester . predict ( cam_K , image_bgr , [ 1 ], depth = depth_m , use_megapose = True ) WAPR 通过 独立掩码接口 处理该帧，不覆盖上面两个结果字典。对照时保留物体编号及各分支实例对应关系；不能仅凭排名或画面位置把不同检测视为同一实例。 保存 show_6D_vis1 、 show_6D_vis2 及 MegaPose 调试图可检查投影。需要数值对照时先检查 PnP 成功标记和精修有效索引，再统一平移单位：HccePose / MegaPose 返回毫米，WAPR 示例 JSON 返回米。 深度反投影 在彩色图坐标系内，以米制深度 z 与相机内参反投影： PYTHON import numpy as np height , width = depth_m . shape u , v = np . meshgrid ( np . arange ( width ), np . arange ( height )) valid = np . isfinite ( depth_m ) & ( depth_m > 0 ) z = depth_m [ valid ] x = ( u [ valid ] - cam_K [ 0 , 2 ]) * z / cam_K [ 0 , 0 ] y = ( v [ valid ] - cam_K [ 1 , 2 ]) * z / cam_K [ 1 , 1 ] points_camera_m = np . column_stack ([ x , y , z ]) 这里的 cam_K 对应原图，不能换用处理后画布内参；前提是深度已经按同一相机模型配准和校正。无效深度不生成点。对齐时把米制网格顶点用米制位姿变换到相机坐标系，不要给点云再重复乘一次位姿。 图层与视角 点云是观测表面，网格是根据估计位姿放置的模型。观察时可用不同颜色、散点与实面区分两者；旋转检查遮挡区域后，应能复位到相机对齐视角。交互操作形式见 WAPR RGB-D 查看器 。 对称物体可能有多种等价姿态；局部点云缺失也不自动说明位姿错误。投影、深度一致性用于检查几何，精度结论需要与独立真值对比并使用相应评测指标。 公开结果与评测 公开示例图见 MegaPose 与 RGB ，历史公开基准见 BOP 评测 。不同后端的评分定义不同，不能直接把其数值相减来判断谁更准确。首次准备耗时与重复推理耗时应分别记录。

title: Refinement and depth comparison
text: Refinement and depth comparison Compare RGB, MegaPose RGB-D and WAPR with the same images, models, calibration and unit conventions. First run the RGB , MegaPose and WAPR tutorials separately, then preserve each branch’s outputs. Preserve results for the same frame PYTHON # Prepare tester, image_bgr, cam_K and meter depth_m using the preceding tutorials. rgb_results = tester . predict ( cam_K , image_bgr , [ 1 ]) megapose_results = tester . predict ( cam_K , image_bgr , [ 1 ], depth = depth_m , use_megapose = True ) WAPR handles this frame through the separate mask API , without overwriting those two dictionaries. Retain object IDs and instance associations across branches; ranking or screen position alone does not establish instance identity. Save show_6D_vis1 , show_6D_vis2 and MegaPose debug views to inspect projections. For numerical comparisons, check initial PnP success and valid refinement indices before converting units: HccePose / MegaPose translations use millimeters; the WAPR example JSON uses meters. Back-project depth Back-project registered meter depth z using pixel intrinsics: PYTHON import numpy as np height , width = depth_m . shape u , v = np . meshgrid ( np . arange ( width ), np . arange ( height )) valid = np . isfinite ( depth_m ) & ( depth_m > 0 ) z = depth_m [ valid ] x = ( u [ valid ] - cam_K [ 0 , 2 ]) * z / cam_K [ 0 , 0 ] y = ( v [ valid ] - cam_K [ 1 , 2 ]) * z / cam_K [ 1 , 1 ] points_camera_m = np . column_stack ([ x , y , z ]) Use original-image intrinsics, not the processed-canvas matrix. Depth must already be registered and corrected under that camera model. Invalid depth produces no points. Transform meter mesh vertices into camera space using meter poses; do not apply the object pose again to observed camera-space points. Layers and views The point cloud represents observed surfaces; a mesh represents the model placed at an estimated pose. Distinguish them using separate colors and point versus surface rendering. After orbiting to inspect occluded regions, restore camera alignment. See the WAPR RGB-D viewer for interaction examples. Symmetric objects may have equivalent orientations, and missing depth alone does not establish a pose error. Projection and depth checks inspect geometry. Accuracy conclusions require independent ground truth and appropriate metrics. Public results and evaluation See public MegaPose and RGB examples, and historical BOP evaluation . Backend scores have different meanings and cannot be directly subtracted to rank accuracy. Record first-time setup and repeated inference timings separately.

title: ONNX 与 TensorRT
text: ONNX 与 TensorRT 加速 先跑通 PyTorch RGB 示例 。HccePose 可用 ONNX Runtime 执行网络前向计算，TensorRT 则通过 ONNX Runtime 的执行提供程序运行。检测、坐标解码、PnP 和结果整理仍在原流程中。 后端与缓存选择 PYTHON from HccePose.tester import Tester tester = Tester ( dataset , CUDA_DEVICE = '0' , hccepose_vis = False , hccepose_acceleration = 'onnx' , hccepose_acceleration_cache_dir = None , ) results = tester . predict ( cam_K , image_bgr , [ 1 ]) 将 'onnx' 改为 'tensorrt' 选择 TensorRT， 'pytorch' 为默认路径。 acceleration 与 acceleration_cache_dir 是兼容别名。上述参数不切换 YOLO 或 MegaPose 的执行后端。 默认每个物体使用 <dataset>/HccePose/obj_XX/onnx_cache/ ，其中包含导出模型及 TensorRT engine 缓存。文件名记录 checkpoint、输入尺寸等信息，不要把不同网络或设备的缓存混用。首次导出与 engine 构建可能显著增加启动时间。 初始化与环境变化 选择 ONNX/TensorRT 时， ensure_acceleration_backend_environment 会检查工具包、PyTorch 和常用依赖，并可能通过当前解释器安装缺失包。使用独立环境；主环境中的 CUDA PyTorch 需先安装好。 环境准备可能调整 NumPy 到 1.26.4 ，安装指定 OpenCV 包。 ONNX Runtime 已能导入时，不保证它就是 GPU 版本；检查实际 provider。 TensorRT 需要兼容的 ONNX Runtime、CUDA、驱动与 libnvinfer 。仅安装 tensorrt Python 包不代表当前 ONNX Runtime 支持 TensorRT。 TMPDIR 与 PIP_CACHE_DIR 可用于选择临时目录及 pip 缓存；不要把模型资源目录与临时目录混淆。 源码与上游接口见 HccePose runner 。当前项目保留 HccePose 网络加速入口。 检查 provider 与输出 PYTHON runner = tester . HccePose_Runtime_Item [ 1 ] print ( runner . session . get_providers ()) ONNX 路径优先 CUDA，再到 CPU；TensorRT 路径优先 TensorRT，再到 CUDA、CPU，实际可用性取决于安装。注册 provider 与每个算子的实际执行并非完全等价，需要结合 ONNX Runtime 日志。完整 HccePose 流程仍需要 CUDA。 对比后端时，固定图像、权重、PnP 设置及可视化开关，并分别保存结果。掩码和坐标差异反映数值一致性，最终精度需按 BOP 对照真值评估。多实例场景不能仅按列表位置匹配两个独立检测结果。 对比示例与计时 公开上游包含 ONNX 对比脚本 与 TensorRT 对比脚本 。它们位于上游根目录，需按实际资源调整输入路径。 首次运行可能包含下载、依赖安装、导出或构建，不应计入稳定重复推理的速度。 time 和 time_dict 为墙钟计时，定义见 结果字段 。主机与 GPU 间的数据搬运、检测和 PnP 仍可能成为瓶颈，因此网络前向加速不等于整条流程同比加速。

title: ONNX and TensorRT
text: ONNX and TensorRT acceleration First run the PyTorch RGB example . HccePose can execute its network forward pass with ONNX Runtime; TensorRT uses ONNX Runtime’s execution provider. Detection, coordinate decoding, PnP and result assembly remain in the existing pipeline. Select a backend and cache PYTHON from HccePose.tester import Tester tester = Tester ( dataset , CUDA_DEVICE = '0' , hccepose_vis = False , hccepose_acceleration = 'onnx' , hccepose_acceleration_cache_dir = None , ) results = tester . predict ( cam_K , image_bgr , [ 1 ]) Change 'onnx' to 'tensorrt' for TensorRT; 'pytorch' is the default. acceleration and acceleration_cache_dir are compatibility aliases. These arguments do not select YOLO or MegaPose backends. Each object defaults to <dataset>/HccePose/obj_XX/onnx_cache/ , including exports and TensorRT engine caches. Filenames identify the checkpoint, input size and related details. Do not mix caches from incompatible networks or devices. Initial export and engine building can substantially increase startup time. Initialization and environment changes Selecting ONNX/TensorRT invokes ensure_acceleration_backend_environment , which checks the toolkit, PyTorch and common dependencies and may install missing packages using the current interpreter. Use a dedicated environment and install CUDA-enabled PyTorch beforehand. Preparation may change NumPy to 1.26.4 and install pinned OpenCV packages. An importable ONNX Runtime is not necessarily GPU-enabled; inspect its actual providers. TensorRT requires compatible ONNX Runtime, CUDA, drivers and libnvinfer . Installing the tensorrt Python package alone does not ensure this ONNX Runtime supports TensorRT. TMPDIR and PIP_CACHE_DIR can select temporary storage and pip caches; distinguish these from model resources. See the public HccePose runner . The current project retains the HccePose network acceleration entry point. Inspect providers and outputs PYTHON runner = tester . HccePose_Runtime_Item [ 1 ] print ( runner . session . get_providers ()) The ONNX path prefers CUDA, then CPU; TensorRT prefers TensorRT, CUDA, then CPU, subject to availability. Registered providers do not fully describe actual operator placement; consult ONNX Runtime logs. The complete HccePose pipeline still requires CUDA. For comparisons, fix images, weights, PnP options and visualization settings, and preserve separate results. Mask and coordinate differences measure numerical agreement. Accuracy needs ground-truth BOP evaluation . Do not match independent multi-instance detections merely by list position. Comparison recipes and timing Public upstream includes ONNX and TensorRT comparison scripts . They live in the upstream root; adjust input paths for your assets. First use may include downloads, installation, export or engine building. Separate those from repeated inference. time and time_dict are wall-clock measurements defined in results . Host/GPU transfers, detection and PnP can remain bottlenecks; faster network execution does not imply proportional end-to-end acceleration.

title: 网格与对称信息
text: 准备网格、旋转对称信息和模型元数据 本页使用 公开上游源码 中的准备、训练或评测脚本。请先按 安装说明 获取该版本，并在上游源码根目录执行本页命令；当前项目中的 examples/inference/ 用于应用推理。 从 CAD 模型到训练数据，先要定好物体的坐标系、尺度和编号。下面用 Bin-Picking 示例物体 走一遍。后续脚本共用数据集的 models/ 目录，并以毫米为模型坐标单位。 从 CAD 导出网格 我们在 SolidWorks 中设计了示例零件，并导出为 board.STL 。你可以从这个文件开始，也可以使用自己的模型。 用 MeshLab 打开 STL，在 Vertex Color Filling 中为表面着色。 导出为 ASCII PLY，并勾选顶点颜色和法向量。 将模型居中并设置物体 ID 导出网格时，原点可能落在零件中心之外。 s1_p1_obj_rename_center.py 使用 PyMeshLab。单独安装脚本使用的参考版本： BASH python -m pip install pymeshlab == 2023 .12.post1 在脚本中设置 input_ply 和 obj_id ，然后从仓库根目录运行。每个物体分配一个唯一的非负整数 ID。脚本把网格包围盒的中心平移到原点，按 BOP 规则命名文件，保存在输入网格旁边。平移会保留原有尺度，因此请先确认顶点坐标以 毫米 为单位。 输入文件 物体 ID 输出文件 board.ply 1 obj_000001.ply board.ply 2 obj_000002.ply 把处理好的文件放入数据集的 models/ 目录。 BASH 数据集名称 | --- models | --- obj_000001.ply ... | --- obj_000015.ply 用 KASAL 标注旋转对称性 圆锥、圆柱和多面体在不同的旋转下可能具有相同的外观。 KASAL 提供八类旋转对称，可以用来拟合对称轴并保存 BOP 所需的对称信息。 BASH pip install kasal-6d 将 mesh_path 指向你的数据集，启动图形界面： PYTHON from kasal.app.polyscope_app import app mesh_path = 'demo-bin-picking' app ( mesh_path ) KASAL 会读取该目录下的 PLY 和 OBJ 网格，并跳过已生成的 _sym.ply 可视化文件。 在 Symmetry Type 中选择类型。对于 n 阶棱锥或棱柱对称，用 N (n-fold) 设置阶数。 对具有纹理旋转对称性的物体，勾选 ADI-C 。 检查可视化中的对称轴是否与模型吻合。如果偏离，先复核对称类型，必要时用 axis xyz 手动拟合。 点击 Cal Current Obj 计算当前物体的对称轴。以物体 1 为例， obj_000001_sym_type.json 保存对称信息， obj_000001_sym.ply 用于查看拟合结果。 生成 BOP 模型元数据 将 s1_p3_obj_infos.py 中的 dataset_path 指向数据集并运行。脚本读取 models/ 中的 BOP 网格，计算直径和包围盒，并将可用的旋转对称信息一起写入 models_info.json 。后续 渲染训练场景 和制作标签时，使用这一套模型和元数据。 BASH 数据集名称 | --- models | --- models_info.json | --- obj_000001.ply ... | --- obj_000015.ply

title: Meshes and symmetry
text: Prepare meshes, symmetry annotations and model metadata This page uses preparation, training or evaluation scripts from the public upstream source . Obtain that revision as described in Installation , and run these commands from its root. The current project’s examples/inference/ provides application inference. Start by choosing a coordinate frame, scale and ID for each object. This example follows the Bin-Picking part from CAD to a training mesh. The rest of the pipeline reads meshes from the dataset’s models/ directory and uses millimeters for model coordinates. Export a mesh from CAD We designed the sample part in SolidWorks and exported it as board.STL . You can start with this file or use your own model. Open the STL in MeshLab and use Vertex Color Filling to color the surface. Export the mesh as an ASCII PLY with vertex colors and normals. Center the mesh and assign an object ID The origin of an exported mesh may lie away from the center of the part. The centering script, s1_p1_obj_rename_center.py , uses PyMeshLab. Install the reference version separately: BASH python -m pip install pymeshlab == 2023 .12.post1 Set input_ply and obj_id in the script, then run it from the repository root. Give each object a unique non-negative integer ID. The script translates the center of the mesh’s bounding box to the origin and saves the renamed BOP file next to the input. Centering preserves scale, so check that the vertex coordinates are already in millimeters . Input Object ID Output board.ply 1 obj_000001.ply board.ply 2 obj_000002.ply Move the prepared meshes to the dataset’s models/ directory. BASH Dataset_Name | --- models | --- obj_000001.ply ... | --- obj_000015.ply Annotate rotational symmetry with KASAL Cones, cylinders and polyhedra can look identical under different rotations. KASAL supports eight types of rotational symmetry and lets you fit the axes and save the symmetry information needed by BOP. BASH pip install kasal-6d Set mesh_path to the dataset directory and open the graphical interface: PYTHON from kasal.app.polyscope_app import app mesh_path = 'demo-bin-picking' app ( mesh_path ) KASAL reads PLY and OBJ meshes under that directory and skips generated _sym.ply visualizations. Choose a Symmetry Type . For n -fold pyramidal or prismatic symmetry, set N (n-fold) . Enable ADI-C for objects with rotational texture symmetry. Compare the displayed axes with the mesh. If they do not line up, check the selected symmetry type and use axis xyz to fit the axes manually if needed. Choose Cal Current Obj to compute the axes. For object 1, obj_000001_sym_type.json stores the symmetry information and obj_000001_sym.ply shows the fitted result. Generate BOP model metadata Set dataset_path in s1_p3_obj_infos.py and run the script. It reads the BOP meshes in models/ , calculates each object’s diameter and bounding box, and writes these along with any available symmetry information to models_info.json . Use the same meshes and metadata for rendering the training scenes and generating labels. BASH Dataset_Name | --- models | --- models_info.json | --- obj_000001.ply ... | --- obj_000015.ply
