title: 检测器训练
text:
训练 2D 检测器 本页使用 公开上游源码 中的准备、训练或评测脚本。请先按 安装说明 获取该版本，并在上游源码根目录执行本页命令；当前项目中的 examples/inference/ 用于应用推理。 HccePose(BF) 先用 YOLOv11 找到物体，再根据每个检测框内的图像估计 6D 位姿。要为自己的物体训练检测器，先将 PBR 渲染数据 中的图像和 BOP 标注转换为 YOLO 格式。 准备图像和检测框标签 公开 s3_p1_prepare_yolo_label.py 展示转换过程。该固定版本的入口路径拼接会重复加入数据集根目录，直接只替换占位字符串可能找不到文件。可将下面脚本保存在上游源码根目录，显式保留数据根、PBR 和输出三个不同路径；将 dataset_root 改为自己的数据位置。 PYTHON import json import os import sys project_dir = os . path . dirname ( os . path . abspath ( __file__ )) sys . path . insert ( 0 , project_dir ) from yolo_train.label import convert_train_pbr_2_yolo , generate_yaml if __name__ == '__main__' : dataset_root = os . path . join ( project_dir , 'data' , 'demo-bin-picking' ) pbr_path = os . path . join ( dataset_root , 'train_pbr' ) output_path = os . path . join ( dataset_root , 'yolo11' , 'train_obj_s' ) info_path = os . path . join ( dataset_root , 'models' , 'models_info.json' ) with open ( info_path , encoding = 'utf-8' ) as handle : object_ids = list ( json . load ( handle )) convert_train_pbr_2_yolo ( pbr_path , output_path , object_ids ) generate_yaml ( output_path , object_ids ) 转换结果位于 yolo11/train_obj_s/ 下。 images/ 和 labels/ 分别保存图像和检测框标注。 data_objs.yaml 是训练配置，两个 autosplit_*.txt 文件分别列出训练和验证样本。 TEXT demo-bin-picking

title: Detector training
text:
Train the 2D detector This page uses preparation, training or evaluation scripts from the public upstream source . Obtain that revision as described in Installation , and run these commands from its root. The current project’s examples/inference/ provides application inference. HccePose(BF) uses YOLOv11 to locate objects and estimates a 6D pose from each detected crop. To train a detector for your objects, convert the images and BOP annotations from your PBR scenes to YOLO format. Prepare images and bounding-box labels The public s3_p1_prepare_yolo_label.py illustrates conversion, but that fixed revision repeats the dataset root during path assembly. Merely replacing its placeholder can select nonexistent paths. Save this recipe in the upstream root, keeping dataset, PBR and output paths separate; set dataset_root to your data. PYTHON import json import os import sys project_dir = os . path . dirname ( os . path . abspath ( __file__ )) sys . path . insert ( 0 , project_dir ) from yolo_train.label import convert_train_pbr_2_yolo , generate_yaml if __name__ == '__main__' : dataset_root = os . path . join ( project_dir , 'data' , 'demo-bin-picking' ) pbr_path = os . path . join ( dataset_root , 'train_pbr' ) output_path = os . path . join ( dataset_root , 'yolo11' , 'train_obj_s' ) info_path = os . path . join ( dataset_root , 'models' , 'models_info.json' ) with open ( info_path , encoding = 'utf-8' ) as handle : object_ids = list ( json . load ( handle )) convert_train_pbr_2_yolo ( pbr_path , output_path , object_ids ) generate_yaml ( output_path , object_ids ) The converter writes the dataset to yolo11/train_obj_s/ . The images/ and labels/ directories hold the images and bounding boxes. The data_objs.yaml file contains the training configuration, and the two autosplit_*.txt files list the training and validation images. TEXT demo-bin-picking
|--- models
|--- train_pbr
|--- yolo11
      |--- train_obj_s
            |--- images
            |--- labels
            |--- yolo_configs
                |--- data_objs.yaml
            |--- autosplit_train.txt
            |--- autosplit_val.txt Train the detector and locate the weights The example trains for 100 epochs on eight GPUs. Set gpu_num in s3_p2_train_yolo.py to match your machine, then run: BASH python s3_p2_train_yolo.py Inference loads yolo11/train_obj_s/detection/obj_s/yolo11-detection-obj_s.pt . The training script skips training if detection/obj_s/ already exists, even when the final weights are missing. Inspect that directory before retrying an interrupted run. If the outer script starts training, yolo_train/train.py checks for yolo11/train_obj_s/train/weights/last.pt and requests resume=True when it finds that checkpoint. TEXT demo-bin-picking
|--- models
|--- train_pbr
|--- yolo11
      |--- train_obj_s
            |--- detection
                |--- obj_s
                    |--- yolo11-detection-obj_s.pt
            |--- images
            |--- labels
            |--- yolo_configs
                |--- data_objs.yaml
            |--- autosplit_train.txt
            |--- autosplit_val.txt Next, generate the front and back coordinate labels for the pose network. Do not append relative dataset roots twice. Confirm the final file exists before inference.

title: 前后表面坐标标签
text:
生成正背面坐标标签 本页使用 公开上游源码 中的准备、训练或评测脚本。请先按 安装说明 获取该版本，并在上游源码根目录执行本页命令；当前项目中的 examples/inference/ 用于应用推理。 同一张渲染图中的一个物体像素可以对应两个三维点。沿这个像素的相机射线，最近的表面交点是前表面点，最远的交点是后表面点。两者都用物体坐标表示，作为 HccePose(BF) 的训练标签。 渲染同一像素的两个表面点 标签脚本在同一相机视角下渲染两张深度图。使用 gl.glDepthFunc(gl.GL_LESS) 时保留最小深度，使用 gl.glDepthFunc(gl.GL_GREATER) 时保留最大深度。将两组深度反投影，并用物体的真值位姿变换到物体坐标系，就得到两张三维坐标图。从左到右依次为训练图像、前表面标签和后表面标签。 为旋转对称物体选择一致的标签 旋转对称的物体可以有多个等价位姿。脚本把离散对称和采样后的连续对称都表示成候选变换。即使物体旋转不变，平移也会改变相机看向物体的方向。为减少视角变化对对称标签选择的影响，脚本用渲染深度恢复三维坐标，并通过 RANSAC PnP 估计用于比较候选的旋转 e_rot 。 对每个候选旋转 R_sym ， 选择函数 计算 e_rot @ R_sym - I 的 Frobenius 范数，其中 I 是 3×3 单位矩阵。若没有校正旋转，就使用 rot_pose @ R_sym - I 。比较只使用旋转部分，选定候选后再用完整的对称变换更新标签位姿的旋转和平移。 批量生成标签 准备好渲染后的 train_pbr 和模型元数据，在 s4_p1_gen_bf_labels.py 中设置 dataset_path 和 folder_name 。然后从仓库根目录运行： BASH python s4_p1_gen_bf_labels.py 脚本使用多个进程逐个处理物体，在数据集下生成 train_pbr_xyz_GT_front/ 和 train_pbr_xyz_GT_back/ 。检查两套标签都已生成后，即可 训练位姿网络 。 TEXT demo-bin-picking

|--- train_pbr
|--- train_pbr_xyz_GT_back
|--- train_pbr_xyz_GT_front 物体编号、实例序号、场景与图像编号必须与原 BOP 标注对应。不要用文件数量代替抽查：同时检查前后标签、物体轮廓、遮挡边缘和物体坐标范围。

title: Front/back coordinate labels
text:
Generate front and back coordinate labels This page uses preparation, training or evaluation scripts from the public upstream source . Obtain that revision as described in Installation , and run these commands from its root. The current project’s examples/inference/ provides application inference. A pixel on a rendered object can correspond to two 3D points. Along the camera ray through that pixel, the nearest surface intersection gives the front point and the farthest intersection gives the back point. HccePose(BF) learns both points in object coordinates. Render both surfaces from the same view The label generator renders two depth maps with the same camera and object pose. With gl.glDepthFunc(gl.GL_LESS) , the depth test keeps the smallest depth at each pixel. With gl.glDepthFunc(gl.GL_GREATER) , it keeps the largest. Back-projecting each depth map and applying the inverse of the ground-truth object-to-camera pose gives two maps of object coordinates. From left to right, the images show the training image, front-surface labels and back-surface labels. Choose consistent labels for rotationally symmetric objects A rotationally symmetric object can have several equivalent poses. The generator builds a set of candidate transformations from the discrete symmetries and samples of any continuous symmetry. Translating an object changes the viewing direction even if its rotation stays fixed. To account for this when choosing a label, the generator recovers 3D points from rendered depth and estimates a corrected rotation, e_rot , with RANSAC PnP. For each candidate rotation R_sym , the selection function evaluates the Frobenius norm of e_rot @ R_sym - I , where I is the 3×3 identity. If no corrected rotation is available, it uses rot_pose @ R_sym - I . The rotation determines which candidate has the smallest norm. The full symmetry transform then updates both rotation and translation in the label pose. Generate labels in batches Prepare the rendered train_pbr scenes and model metadata. Set dataset_path and folder_name in s4_p1_gen_bf_labels.py , then run the script from the repository root: BASH python s4_p1_gen_bf_labels.py The script processes each object with multiple workers. It writes the two sets of maps to train_pbr_xyz_GT_front/ and train_pbr_xyz_GT_back/ . Check both directories before training the pose network . TEXT demo-bin-picking
|--- models
|--- train_pbr
|--- train_pbr_xyz_GT_back
|--- train_pbr_xyz_GT_front Keep object, instance, scene and image identifiers aligned with the original BOP annotations. File counts alone are insufficient: inspect both surface labels, silhouettes, occlusion boundaries and object-coordinate ranges.

title: Tester 接口
text: Tester 接口 HccePose.tester.Tester 处理单张 OpenCV 图像或视频帧。检测器为已知物体产生区域，逐物体网络预测掩码及前后表面坐标，PnP 求解位姿。一个物体类别可以出现多个实例。 构造器 PYTHON from HccePose.tester import Tester tester = Tester ( bop_dataset_item , show_op = True , hccepose_vis = None , CUDA_DEVICE = '0' , top_K = None , crop_size = 256 , efficientnet_key = None , megapose_model_name_rgb = 'megapose-1.0-RGB-multi-hypothesis' , megapose_model_name_rgbd = 'megapose-1.0-RGBD' , hccepose_acceleration = 'pytorch' , hccepose_acceleration_cache_dir = None , ) 参数 含义 bop_dataset_item BOP 加载器 ，提供模型、权重根目录及物体顺序。 hccepose_vis 非 None 时覆盖 show_op ；控制四个基础可视化字段。 CUDA_DEVICE CUDA 编号字符串，如 '0' 。当前推理流程需要 CUDA。 top_K 预留参数，不限制实际检测或位姿数量。 crop_size 默认 256 ；需与网络及可视化布局匹配，不用于更改原图分辨率。 efficientnet_key None 使用 ResNet 分支，其他值选择 EfficientNet；必须匹配权重。 megapose_model_name_rgb 、 megapose_model_name_rgbd MegaPose 注册时采用的模型名称。 hccepose_acceleration 'pytorch' 、 'onnx' 或 'tensorrt' ，仅选择网络执行后端。 hccepose_acceleration_cache_dir 导出及后端缓存目录； None 时使用各物体的默认目录。 兼容参数 acceleration 和 acceleration_cache_dir 仍可使用，非 None 时覆盖对应的 HccePose 专用参数。加速行为见 加速说明 。 初始化会加载 models_info.json 中的全部物体，而不只加载之后请求预测的编号。每个物体都需有匹配的位姿权重。YOLO 类别索引通过加载器的 obj_id_list 映射到 BOP 物体编号，因此元数据顺序必须与检测器训练时一致。 即使初始化打印 CPU 回退信息，创建物体边界张量和加载权重仍有 CUDA 路径，不能据此认为支持完整 CPU 推理。损坏或不兼容的 checkpoint 会报告对应物体、路径及原因。 预测 PYTHON results = tester . predict ( cam_K , image_bgr , object_ids , confidence_threshold = 0.75 , conf = 0.75 , iou = 0.50 , max_det = 200 , pnp_op = 'ransac+comb' , depth = None , use_megapose = False , megapose_vis = False , megapose_vis_stages = None , ) 输入 约定 cam_K NumPy 3×3 原图内参，单位为像素，必须对应当前输入尺寸。 image_bgr NumPy H×W×3 、 uint8 ，保持 OpenCV BGR 顺序。 object_ids 请求的 BOP 物体编号，不是 YOLO 类别索引；每个编号可返回多个实例。 conf 传给 YOLO 的检测置信度阈值。 confidence_threshold 仅控制 2D 检测图的绘制，不过滤返回的位姿。 iou 、 max_det 传给 YOLO 的检测去重参数和数量上限。 pnp_op epnp 、 ransac 、 ransac+vvs 、 ransac+comb 或 ransac+vvs+comb 。 depth 可选的配准深度， H×W ，单位为米；提供后可用于 MegaPose RGB-D。 use_megapose 请求 MegaPose 精修；未注册时在首次使用时注册。 megapose_vis 、 megapose_vis_stages 请求 MegaPose 调试图及阶段选择。 组合 PnP 模式需要 checkpoint 中的 keypoints_ 先验；缺少时会在检测前报错，不会静默替换求解方式。输出中的 pnp_success 用于逐实例判断初始 PnP 是否成功。 最长边超过 640 像素的输入会先缩小，再按检测器 32 像素步长补边；内参和可选深度同步调整。二维结果字段以处理后画布为准。完整图像掩码须通过 还原函数 回到输入分辨率。 PYTHON # 模型只初始化一次；在图片列表或视频循环中重复调用。 results = tester . predict ( cam_K , image_bgr , [ 1 ]) entry = results . get ( 1 ) if entry is not None : valid = entry [ 'pnp_success' ] poses_mm = entry [ 'Rts' ][ valid ] print ( poses_mm [:, : 3 , 3 ]) 没有检出的物体不会有对应整数键；字符串键保存计时和图像等信息。完整字段见 结果字典 。WAPR 通过独立的 掩码接入函数 调用。

title: Tester API
text: Tester API HccePose.tester.Tester processes one OpenCV image or video frame. A detector proposes regions for known objects, per-object networks predict masks and front/back coordinates, and PnP estimates poses. Each object category may have multiple instances. Constructor PYTHON from HccePose.tester import Tester tester = Tester ( bop_dataset_item , show_op = True , hccepose_vis = None , CUDA_DEVICE = '0' , top_K = None , crop_size = 256 , efficientnet_key = None , megapose_model_name_rgb = 'megapose-1.0-RGB-multi-hypothesis' , megapose_model_name_rgbd = 'megapose-1.0-RGBD' , hccepose_acceleration = 'pytorch' , hccepose_acceleration_cache_dir = None , ) Argument Meaning bop_dataset_item BOP loader containing models, the asset root and object ordering. hccepose_vis Overrides show_op when not None ; controls the four base visualization fields. CUDA_DEVICE CUDA index as a string, such as '0' . The current inference pipeline requires CUDA. top_K Reserved; does not limit detections or poses. crop_size Defaults to 256 ; must match the network and visualization layout, rather than the original image size. efficientnet_key None selects ResNet; other values select EfficientNet. Must match the checkpoint. megapose_model_name_rgb , megapose_model_name_rgbd Model names used when registering MegaPose. hccepose_acceleration 'pytorch' , 'onnx' or 'tensorrt' ; selects the network execution backend. hccepose_acceleration_cache_dir Export/backend cache location, or None for per-object defaults. The compatibility arguments acceleration and acceleration_cache_dir remain available. Non- None values override the corresponding HccePose-specific settings. See acceleration . Initialization loads every object listed in models_info.json , rather than only the IDs later requested for prediction. Each needs a matching checkpoint. YOLO category indices map through the loader’s obj_id_list , whose order must match detector training. A CPU fallback message during initialization does not imply full CPU support: object-bound tensors and checkpoint loading still use CUDA paths. Invalid or incompatible checkpoints report the object, path and cause. Prediction PYTHON results = tester . predict ( cam_K , image_bgr , object_ids , confidence_threshold = 0.75 , conf = 0.75 , iou = 0.50 , max_det = 200 , pnp_op = 'ransac+comb' , depth = None , use_megapose = False , megapose_vis = False , megapose_vis_stages = None , ) Input Contract cam_K NumPy 3×3 original-image intrinsics in pixels, matching the input dimensions. image_bgr NumPy H×W×3 , uint8 , in OpenCV BGR order. object_ids BOP object IDs, not YOLO category indices; each may return multiple instances. conf Detection confidence threshold passed to YOLO. confidence_threshold Controls only drawing in the 2D detection image; does not filter returned poses. iou , max_det Detector suppression setting and maximum number of detections passed to YOLO. pnp_op epnp , ransac , ransac+vvs , ransac+comb or ransac+vvs+comb . depth Optional registered H×W depth in meters; enables the MegaPose RGB-D model. use_megapose Requests refinement; registers MegaPose on first use if needed. megapose_vis , megapose_vis_stages Request MegaPose debug images and select stages. Combined PnP modes require keypoints_ in the checkpoint. Missing priors raise before detection rather than silently changing the solver. Inspect pnp_success for each instance’s initial PnP status. Inputs whose longest side exceeds 640 pixels are resized and then padded to the detector’s 32-pixel stride. Intrinsics and optional depth are adjusted together. Pixel-valued result fields use this processed canvas. Use the mask restoration helper to return to input resolution. PYTHON # Initialize the models once; repeat prediction for images or video frames. results = tester . predict ( cam_K , image_bgr , [ 1 ]) entry = results . get ( 1 ) if entry is not None : valid = entry [ 'pnp_success' ] poses_mm = entry [ 'Rts' ][ valid ] print ( poses_mm [:, : 3 , 3 ]) Undetected objects have no corresponding integer key. String keys contain timings and images. See the results dictionary . Call WAPR through the separate mask integration function .

text: 结果与坐标 HccePose Tester.predict 按物体编号返回结果。每组的 pnp_success[i] 表示第 i 个检测实例的 HccePose PnP 是否求解成功。读取 RGB 位姿前先检查这个布尔值。可用对应点不足时，求解器可能返回单位矩阵，此时 pnp_success[i] 为 False 。启用可选精修时，这个标志仍只记录初始 PnP 状态。 Rts[i] 为物体到相机的 4×4 变换，平移单位为毫米。 pred_mask[i] 位于裁剪图像坐标系。还原到原图时，使用已有辅助函数完成裁剪逆变换、去除补边和分辨率恢复： PYTHON from Refinement.wapr_public import restore_full_frame_masks mask_i = restore_full_frame_masks ( results [ obj_id ], image_bgr . shape )[ i ] image_bgr 为传入 predict 的原始图像， i 为该物体组内的实例索引。函数使用匹配的 Detect_Bbox_tfs_128 ，返回原图大小的布尔掩码。 WAPR pose_4x4_m 表示物体到相机的位姿，平移单位为米。接入示例的 score_6d 由 WAPR 根据本次输入计算，并非 YOLO 检测置信度，不保证位于概率区间。 输入与输出保持相同实例顺序；示例保存的 instance_index 是物体组内索引，不代表检测器全局框编号或真实物体标签。 坐标和颜色顺序变换均在接入边界显式进行，原始 Tester 的毫米约定不变。 每个物体的完整字段 以下形状使用默认 crop_size=256 ； N 为当前物体的实例数。张量可能位于 GPU，转为 NumPy 前先 detach().cpu() 。 字段 类型 / 形状 含义 Rts NumPy N × 4 × 4 物体到相机位姿，平移为毫米；MegaPose 可覆盖成功实例。 pred_mask torch N × 128 × 128 网络裁剪空间内的二值掩码。 coord_2d_image torch N × 128 × 128 × 2 缩放及补边后输入画布中的像素坐标。 pred_front_code_obj 、 pred_back_code_obj torch N × 128 × 128 × 3 物体坐标系下的正背面解码坐标，使用模型单位。 pred_front_code 、 pred_back_code torch N × 128 × 128 × 3 解码并归一化到 [0, 1] 的坐标。 pred_front_code_raw 、 正背面编码 logits。 Detect_Bbox_tfs_128 torch N × 3 × 3 从处理后画布映射到网络输出裁剪图的单应变换。 crop_rgbs torch N × 3 × 256 × 256 BGR 裁剪图，使用按 BGR 重排的 ImageNet 统计量归一化。 pnp_success NumPy bool N 初始 HccePose PnP 的成功状态。 conf torch N YOLO 检测分数；不是 WAPR 评分。 可视化与耗时 顶层键 含义 show_2D_results YOLO 检测框图。 show_6D_vis0 实例裁剪、掩码与前后表面编码拼图。 show_6D_vis1 处理后整图上的坐标和位姿组合展示。 show_6D_vis2 紧凑的整图位姿展示。 show_megapose 请求并生成 MegaPose 调试图时出现。 time 从检测前到位姿计算完成的秒数，不含模型初始化和之后的可视化。 time_dict yolo 、 hccepose 、 megapose 、 visualization 、 other 的墙钟计时。 四个基础图像字段需要 hccepose_vis=True 。图像为 BGR，可含多个拼接面板，尺寸不一定等于原图。 time_dict 包含可视化，而 time 在可视化前结束，不能要求两者相加一致；这些计时也不等同于同步 GPU 基准。 MegaPose 成功返回评分时， Rts_hccepose 保留初值， Rts 更新成功的位姿； megapose_scores 与 megapose_valid_pose_ids 对齐，不应按全部实例下标直接索引。 pnp_success 仍只表示原始 PnP 状态。见 精修接口 。 PYTHON # 转为米制平移时显式换算，旋转保持不变。 entry = results . get ( 1 ) if entry is not None : translations_m = entry [ 'Rts' ][:, : 3 , 3 ] * 1e-3

title: Results and coordinates
text: Results and coordinates HccePose Tester.predict groups detections by object ID. Within a group, pnp_success[i] records whether HccePose’s PnP solver succeeded for detection i . Check this boolean before using an RGB pose. With too few correspondences the solver can return the identity matrix and pnp_success[i] is False . When optional refinement is enabled, the flag still describes the initial PnP solve. Rts[i] is a 4×4 object-to-camera transform with translation in millimeters. The mask pred_mask[i] is in crop coordinates. Use the existing helper to invert the crop transform, remove padding and restore the original resolution: PYTHON from Refinement.wapr_public import restore_full_frame_masks mask_i = restore_full_frame_masks ( results [ obj_id ], image_bgr . shape )[ i ] image_bgr is the original image passed to predict , and i is the instance index within that object group. The helper uses the matching Detect_Bbox_tfs_128 and returns boolean masks at the original image size. WAPR pose_4x4_m is an object-to-camera pose with meter translations. The adapter’s score_6d is computed by WAPR for the current input. It differs from YOLO confidence and is not guaranteed to lie in a probability interval. Results preserve input instance order. The saved instance_index is local to an object group, not a detector-global box ID or ground-truth label. Coordinate and channel-order conversions occur explicitly at the adapter boundary. The original Tester's millimeter convention is unchanged. Per-object fields Shapes below use the default crop_size=256 ; N is the instance count for that object. Tensors may reside on the GPU; call detach().cpu() before NumPy conversion. Field Type / shape Meaning Rts NumPy N × 4 × 4 Final poses; translation in mm. Refinement may replace the initial poses. pred_mask torch N × 128 × 128 Binary mask in network crop space. coord_2d_image torch N × 128 × 128 × 2 Pixel coordinates in the resized/padded input canvas. pred_front_code_obj , pred_back_code_obj torch N × 128 × 128 × 3 Decoded front/back coordinates in model space, using model units. pred_front_code , pred_back_code torch N × 128 × 128 × 3 Decoded coordinates normalized to [0, 1] . pred_front_code_raw , pred_back_code_raw torch N × 128 × 128 × 24 Display values computed as (logits + 1) / 2 , then clamped to [0, 1] ; these are not unmodified logits. pred_mask_logits torch N × 1 × 128 × 128 Mask logits. pred_front_back_code_logits torch N × 48 × 128 × 128 Front/back code logits. Detect_Bbox_tfs_128 torch N × 3 × 3 Homographies from the processed canvas into network output crops. crop_rgbs torch N × 3 × 256 × 256 BGR crops normalized with BGR-permuted ImageNet statistics. pnp_success NumPy bool N Initial HccePose PnP success status. conf torch N YOLO detection score, distinct from WAPR scores. Visualization and timing Top-level key Meaning show_2D_results YOLO detection boxes. show_6D_vis0 Instance crops, masks and front/back code montage. show_6D_vis1 Combined coordinate and pose views of the processed image. show_6D_vis2 Compact full-scene pose view. show_megapose Present when requested MegaPose debug images are generated. time Seconds from before detection through pose computation; excludes initialization and subsequent visualization. time_dict Wall-clock timings for yolo , hccepose , megapose , visualization , and other . The four base images require hccepose_vis=True . They use BGR and may combine multiple panels, so their dimensions need not equal the original image. time_dict includes visualization, whereas time ends before it. Their totals need not agree, and neither is a synchronized GPU benchmark. When MegaPose returns scores, Rts_hccepose preserves the initial poses and Rts updates successful poses. megapose_scores aligns with megapose_valid_pose_ids , not necessarily every instance row. pnp_success still describes only initial PnP. See the refinement API . PYTHON # Convert translations explicitly to meters; rotations are unchanged. entry = results . get ( 1 ) if entry is not None : translations_m = entry [ 'Rts' ][:, : 3 , 3 ] * 1e-3

title: 位姿精修与 RGB-D 接口
text: 位姿精修与 RGB-D 接口 RGB 推理只需彩色图像与内参。引入深度时，先完成像素配准、单位检查，再选择 WAPR 或 MegaPose 。它们的入口、初值要求和评分含义不同。 输入与单位 项目 HccePose / MegaPose 接入 WAPR 掩码接入 彩色图 OpenCV BGR uint8 H×W×3 接入函数接收 BGR，内部转为公开 API 所需 RGB。 深度 MegaPose RGB 可省略；RGB-D 为米制 H×W 必需，有限、非负、米制 H×W 。 相机 原图对应的像素内参 3×3 与原图、深度和完整掩码一致的像素内参。 模型 BOP 模型按毫米注册，内部转换 网格顶点与 diameter_m 都为米。 初始位姿 MegaPose 从 HccePose 位姿精修 当前掩码估计入口不接收 HccePose 位姿初值。 输出平移 Tester 结果保持毫米 pose_4x4 / 示例 pose_4x4_m 为米。 图像尺寸相同不代表已经配准。适配器检查尺寸，无法判断传感器外参或畸变是否已正确处理；这些需在输入前完成。 将裁剪掩码还原至原图 PYTHON from Refinement.wapr_public import restore_full_frame_masks entry = predictions [ obj_id ] masks = restore_full_frame_masks ( entry , image_bgr . shape ) 返回布尔数组 N×H×W ，顺序与该物体的裁剪掩码一致。函数先逆变换到缩放补边画布，再去掉边框，恢复原图尺寸。不要直接把 Detect_Bbox_tfs_128 应用到原图，也不要把 128×128 裁剪掩码交给整图深度估计。 可选的 mask_threshold=0.5 仅是掩码前景阈值，不是 WAPR 评分阈值。掩码数量与变换数量不符时明确报错。 调用公开 WAPR 接口 PYTHON import numpy as np import trimesh from wapr.estimator import WAPREstimator from Refinement.wapr_public import estimate_from_masks # 已准备同帧 image_bgr、depth_m、cam_K、masks，以及毫米模型与直径。 mesh = trimesh . load ( mesh_path , force = 'mesh' , process = False ) mesh . apply_scale ( 1e-3 ) diameter_m = diameter_mm * 1e-3 instances = [ { 'mesh' : mesh , 'diameter_m' : diameter_m , 'mask' : mask } for mask in masks ] estimator = WAPREstimator ( device = 'cuda:0' ) results = estimate_from_masks ( estimator , image_bgr , depth_m , cam_K , instances ) for result in results : pose_m = np . asarray ( result [ 'pose_4x4' ]) score = float ( result [ 'score_6d' ]) print ( pose_m , score ) 不同物体的实例可使用不同网格和直径。输入列表每项代表一个实例；输出与该列表一一对应。只需估计已有掩码时无需创建 HccePose Tester ，可直接准备自己的完整图像掩码。 适配器检查深度、内参、掩码尺寸及正深度，验证输出数量、位姿形状与有限分数。空列表返回 [] ，不调用后端；空掩码或区域内没有正深度会报错，而非伪造零分。 当前 score_6d 针对本次输入计算，不是概率或物体标签。估计成功、分数通过与确认目标是不同的判断，接收、去重和排序由应用定义。完整文件入口见 WAPR 教程 。 MegaPose 注册与调用 PYTHON tester . register_megapose () results_rgb = tester . predict ( cam_K , image_bgr , [ 1 ], depth = None , use_megapose = True ) results_rgbd = tester . predict ( cam_K , image_bgr , [ 1 ], depth = depth_m , use_megapose = True ) 不传深度选择 RGB 模型，传入配准米制深度选择 RGB-D。 register_megapose 为加载器中的物体注册毫米网格；推理在独立子环境中执行。评分与有效实例索引见 结果字段 。 重复处理与资源准备 多帧应用应复用已初始化的 HccePose 和 WAPR 对象。导入 Refinement.wapr_public 本身不安装依赖、下载资源或初始化 GPU；主动创建公开后端时可能准备其运行资源。离线前按 安装说明 准备对应缓存。 估计之后若需要应用层分数筛选与渲染掩码 NMS，可使用 可选后处理教程 ，不改变适配器的返回约定。

title: Refinement and RGB-D API
text: Refinement and RGB-D interfaces RGB inference needs only color and intrinsics. Before adding depth, register pixels and check units, then choose WAPR or MegaPose . Their entry points, initialization requirements and scores differ. Inputs and units Item HccePose / MegaPose integration WAPR mask integration Color OpenCV BGR uint8 H×W×3 Adapter accepts BGR and converts to the public API’s RGB order. Depth Optional for MegaPose RGB; meters for RGB-D Required finite, nonnegative H×W values in meters. Camera Original-image 3×3 pixel intrinsics Same pixel intrinsics as color, depth and full-frame masks. Model BOP meshes registered in millimeters, converted internally Both vertices and diameter_m in meters. Initial pose MegaPose refines HccePose hypotheses This mask-estimation entry point does not accept HccePose pose seeds. Translation output Tester results remain millimeters pose_4x4 / example pose_4x4_m uses meters. Equal image dimensions do not prove registration. The adapter checks dimensions, but cannot verify sensor extrinsics or distortion correction; complete those before providing input. Restore crop masks to the original image PYTHON from Refinement.wapr_public import restore_full_frame_masks entry = predictions [ obj_id ] masks = restore_full_frame_masks ( entry , image_bgr . shape ) The result is a boolean N×H×W array in the object’s original crop-mask order. The helper inversely warps into the resized/padded canvas, removes padding, and restores original dimensions. Do not apply Detect_Bbox_tfs_128 directly to the original image or pass 128×128 crop masks against full-frame depth. Optional mask_threshold=0.5 controls mask foreground only, not WAPR score acceptance. Mismatched mask and transform counts raise an error. Call the public WAPR API PYTHON import numpy as np import trimesh from wapr.estimator import WAPREstimator from Refinement.wapr_public import estimate_from_masks # Prepare same-frame image_bgr, depth_m, cam_K, masks, and millimeter mesh/diameter. mesh = trimesh . load ( mesh_path , force = 'mesh' , process = False ) mesh . apply_scale ( 1e-3 ) diameter_m = diameter_mm * 1e-3 instances = [ { 'mesh' : mesh , 'diameter_m' : diameter_m , 'mask' : mask } for mask in masks ] estimator = WAPREstimator ( device = 'cuda:0' ) results = estimate_from_masks ( estimator , image_bgr , depth_m , cam_K , instances ) for result in results : pose_m = np . asarray ( result [ 'pose_4x4' ]) score = float ( result [ 'score_6d' ]) print ( pose_m , score ) Different objects can supply different meshes and diameters. Each list entry represents an instance; outputs align one-to-one with the list. If masks are already available, prepare your own full-frame masks and call this function without creating a HccePose Tester . The adapter checks depth, intrinsics, mask dimensions and observed positive depth, and validates output count, pose shape and finite scores. An empty list returns [] without calling the backend. Empty masks or regions lacking positive depth raise instead of generating artificial zero scores. score_6d is computed for the current input, not a probability or object label. Successful estimation, score acceptance and target confirmation are separate decisions. Applications define acceptance, suppression and ranking. See the WAPR tutorial for the file-based entry point. Register and call MegaPose PYTHON tester . register_megapose () results_rgb = tester . predict ( cam_K , image_bgr , [ 1 ], depth = None , use_megapose = True ) results_rgbd = tester . predict ( cam_K , image_bgr , [ 1 ], depth = depth_m , use_megapose = True ) Omitting depth selects RGB; registered meter depth selects RGB-D. Registration uses all loader objects and millimeter meshes. Inference runs in a separate environment. See results for scores and valid instance indices. Repeated processing and resources Reuse initialized HccePose and WAPR objects across frames. Importing Refinement.wapr_public does not install dependencies, download resources or initialize a GPU. Constructing the public backend may prepare its resources. Populate the caches described in Installation before working offline. For application-level score filtering and rendered-mask NMS after estimation, use the optional postprocessing tutorial . This leaves the adapter return contract unchanged.

title: 数据加载接口
text: 数据加载接口 BOP 加载器读取物体模型及其元数据。用 Tester 处理自己的图片时，准备好模型信息和配套权重即可。需要读取 BOP 场景与标注时再调用 load_folder() 。 模型元数据 PYTHON from HccePose.bop_loader import bop_dataset bop_dataset ( dataset_path , model_name = 'models' , local_rank = 0 ) dataset_path 是数据集根目录， model_name 指定其中的模型子目录， local_rank 控制提示信息输出。加载器读取 <dataset_path>/<model_name>/models_info.json ，并按六位编号构造 obj_000001.ply 形式的模型路径。 属性 含义 dataset_path 、 model_path 数据集根路径和选定的模型目录。 model_info 以字符串物体 ID 为键的模型元数据，包括尺寸、最小坐标、直径及可选对称信息。 obj_id_list 按元数据遍历顺序取得的整数物体 ID。 obj_model_list 与 obj_id_list 对齐的 PLY 路径。 obj_info_list 同一顺序的元数据条目。 YOLO 类别从 0 开始编号。 Tester 将类别索引用作 obj_id_list 的下标来查找物体 ID。更换检测器或整理模型元数据时，务必保留训练时的类别顺序。 数据集根目录或模型目录不存在时，加载器会打印提示并提前返回。缺少 PLY 文件也会打印提示。创建 Tester 或训练数据集前，请检查提示中列出的路径。 Linux 下导入 bop_loader 会设置 PYOPENGL_PLATFORM=egl 。即使只做推理，它仍会导入仓库内的 BOP 工具包和增强依赖。从项目根目录运行 python -m zipfile -e bop_toolkit.zip . ，解压后应存在 bop_toolkit/bop_toolkit_lib/ 。 源码： 导入与 EGL 设置 、 模型加载器 、 检测类别映射 。 场景元数据 PYTHON dataset . load_folder ( folder_name , scene_num = 200 , vis = 0.0 ) folder_name 是相对数据集的目录名，如 train_pbr 或 test 。 scene_num 按连续的六位场景编号扫描，从 000000 到编号 scene_num - 1 。 vis 保留满足 visib_fract >= vis 的标注实例。 按 BOP 目录结构准备 scene_camera.json 、 scene_gt.json 、 scene_gt_info.json ，以及 rgb/ 或 gray/ 、 depth/ 、 mask/ 和 mask_visib/ 。加载器能处理部分标注缺失的情况，但仍会按深度和掩码文件的后缀构造路径。普通 RGB 图片请直接传给 Tester 。 PYTHON { 'img_info' : { ... }, # 键如 "000000_000001"，表示场景号_图像号 'obj_info' : { ... }, # 键如 "obj_000001"，表示物体编号 'scene_path_list' : [ ... ], # 已存在的数字编号场景目录 } img_info 按图像组织路径、相机信息和标注实例， obj_info 按物体组织实例记录。此调用建立元数据索引，图像像素由后续数据集包装器读取。目标文件夹不存在时返回 None 。 源码： load_folder 。 训练与评测包装器 PYTHON train_bop_dataset_back_front ( bop_dataset_item , folder_name , padding_ratio = 1.5 , crop_size_img = 256 , aug_op = 'imgaug' , ) test_bop_dataset_back_front ( bop_dataset_item , folder_name , bbox_2D = None , test_targets_bop19 = None , bbox_2D_score_threshold = 0.0 , padding_ratio = 1.5 , crop_size_img = 256 , ratio = 1.0 , ) 将任一数据集交给 DataLoader 前，先调用 update_obj_id(obj_id, obj_path) 选择物体。两种数据集都按可见比例阈值 0.2 加载场景。初始化时可能创建 <folder_name>_xyz_GT_front/ 和 <folder_name>_xyz_GT_back/ 目录。 训练样本返回 (rgb_c, mask_vis_c, GT_Front_hcce, GT_Back_hcce) 。评测样本追加 (Bbox, cam_K, cam_R_m2c, cam_t_m2c) ；使用外部检测时再追加 (scene_id, image_id, score) 。裁剪图为 BGR 归一化张量。现有训练脚本已处理批次、当前物体选择和 checkpoint 元数据。 缺失的正背面标签图会被零填充。训练前请检查生成的标签，并抽查几个样本。 外部 bbox JSON 条目使用 scene_id 、 image_id 、 category_id 、 bbox 和 score ，分数筛选条件为严格的 score > bbox_2D_score_threshold 。BOP 挑战脚本提供了现成接入示例。 源码： 训练包装器 、 评测包装器 、 样本返回值 。 RGB-D 帧所需的三个文件及深度换算方法见 位姿精修接口 。各训练和评测脚本的用途见 工具与进阶接口 。

title: Data loading API
text: Data loading API The BOP loader reads object-model metadata. For inference on your own images with Tester , prepare the model metadata and matching weights. Call load_folder() when you also need BOP scenes and annotations. Model metadata PYTHON from HccePose.bop_loader import bop_dataset bop_dataset ( dataset_path , model_name = 'models' , local_rank = 0 ) dataset_path is the dataset root, model_name selects its model subdirectory, and local_rank controls informational printing. The loader reads <dataset_path>/<model_name>/models_info.json and constructs model filenames as obj_000001.ply , using six-digit IDs. Attribute Meaning dataset_path , model_path Dataset root and selected model directory. model_info Model metadata keyed by string object IDs. Contains dimensions, minimum coordinates, diameter and optional symmetry information. obj_id_list Integer object IDs in metadata iteration order. obj_model_list PLY paths aligned with obj_id_list . obj_info_list Metadata entries in the same order. YOLO class indices start at zero. Tester uses the class index as a position in obj_id_list to look up the object ID. Preserve the detector's training class order if you replace the detector or reorganize the metadata. If the dataset root or model directory is missing, the loader prints a message and returns early. It also reports missing PLY files. Check any reported paths before creating a Tester or training dataset. On Linux, importing bop_loader sets PYOPENGL_PLATFORM=egl . It imports the repository-local BOP toolkit and augmentation dependencies even when used only for inference. Run python -m zipfile -e bop_toolkit.zip . from the project root; the extracted library is at bop_toolkit/bop_toolkit_lib/ . Sources: imports and EGL setting , model loader , detector class mapping . Scene metadata PYTHON dataset . load_folder ( folder_name , scene_num = 200 , vis = 0.0 ) folder_name is a dataset-relative directory, such as train_pbr or test . scene_num scans consecutive six-digit scene IDs, starting at 000000 and ending at ID scene_num - 1 . vis keeps annotated instances with visib_fract >= vis . Use the BOP scene layout with scene_camera.json , scene_gt.json , scene_gt_info.json , rgb/ or gray/ , depth/ , mask/ and mask_visib/ . The loader handles some missing annotations but uses the depth and mask file extensions when constructing paths. Pass standalone RGB images directly to Tester . PYTHON { 'img_info' : { ... }, # Keys such as "000000_000001" (scene ID_image ID) 'obj_info' : { ... }, # Keys such as "obj_000001" (object ID) 'scene_path_list' : [ ... ], # Existing numeric scene folders } img_info groups paths, camera information and annotated instances by image. obj_info groups instance records by object. The call indexes metadata; image pixels are loaded later by dataset wrappers. If the requested folder does not exist, it returns None . Source: load_folder . Training and evaluation wrappers PYTHON train_bop_dataset_back_front ( bop_dataset_item , folder_name , padding_ratio = 1.5 , crop_size_img = 256 , aug_op = 'imgaug' , ) test_bop_dataset_back_front ( bop_dataset_item , folder_name , bbox_2D = None , test_targets_bop19 = None , bbox_2D_score_threshold = 0.0 , padding_ratio = 1.5 , crop_size_img = 256 , ratio = 1.0 , ) Before passing either dataset to a DataLoader , select the object with update_obj_id(obj_id, obj_path) . Both datasets load scenes with a visibility threshold of 0.2 . Initialization may create the <folder_name>_xyz_GT_front/ and <folder_name>_xyz_GT_back/ directories. Training samples return (rgb_c, mask_vis_c, GT_Front_hcce, GT_Back_hcce) . Evaluation samples additionally return (Bbox, cam_K, cam_R_m2c, cam_t_m2c) ; with external detections they append (scene_id, image_id, score) . Crops are BGR-normalized tensors. Existing training recipes handle batching, current-object selection and checkpoint metadata. Missing front or back label images are filled with zeros. Check the generated labels and inspect a few samples before training. External bbox JSON entries use scene_id , image_id , category_id , bbox , and score ; the score filter is strictly score > bbox_2D_score_threshold . The BOP challenge script provides an existing integration example. Sources: training wrapper , evaluation wrapper , sample return values . See the refinement API for the three files in an RGB-D frame and how to convert its depth. The utilities guide lists the training and evaluation scripts.

title: 工具与进阶接口
text: 工具与进阶接口 用 Tester 完成推理后，可以用这里的工具保存图像、打印分阶段耗时。需要直接调用网络或读取 checkpoint 时，参见下方接口。推理输出的形状和单位见 结果字典 。 保存可视化 PYTHON from HccePose.test_script_utils import save_visual_artifacts save_visual_artifacts ( artifacts , enabled = True ) artifacts 是 (path, image) 二元组的可迭代对象，图像采用 OpenCV BGR H × W × 3 ；保存测试器输出时使用 uint8 图像。 enabled=False 时不写文件、返回 [] 。函数跳过路径或图像为 None 的条目，创建父目录，再调用 cv2.imwrite() 。 PYTHON # output_dir 是选定的本地输出目录。 import os saved_paths = save_visual_artifacts ([ ( os . path . join ( output_dir , 'pose.jpg' ), results . get ( 'show_6D_vis2' )), ( os . path . join ( output_dir , 'detection.jpg' ), results . get ( 'show_2D_results' )), ]) 函数允许覆盖同名文件，并会记录每个尝试写入的路径。它不检查 cv2.imwrite() 的返回值；需要确认写入成功时，请检查目标文件。 源码： save_visual_artifacts 。 打印阶段耗时 PYTHON from HccePose.test_script_utils import print_stage_time_breakdown print_stage_time_breakdown ( results_dict , enabled = False , prefix = '' ) 设置 enabled=True 后打印 time 、各阶段秒数和占比，返回 None 。耗时字典缺失或格式不符时打印 unavailable 提示。百分比以 results_dict['time'] 为分母，但可视化可能位于这一计时区间之外，所以不保证加总为 100%。见 计时定义 。 源码： print_stage_time_breakdown 。 底层可视化 PYTHON vis_rgb_mask_Coord ( rgb_c , pred_mask , pred_front_code , pred_back_code , img_path = None , ) vis_rgb_mask_Coord_origin ( cam_K , obj_ids_l , obj_ids_all , BBox_3d_l , Rts_l , conf_s , rgb_c , pred_mask , pred_front_code , pred_back_code , img_path = None , ) 函数位于 HccePose.visualization 。第一个返回裁剪及编码展示图，第二个返回 (combined_canvas, compact_canvas) ，并投影模型包围盒。输入是归一化 BGR 张量和编码、掩码张量。第二个函数要求掩码与编码已映射到图像画布，位姿与 BBox_3d_l 使用相同模型坐标约定。 vis_rgb_mask_Coord 返回可视化图像，传入 img_path 时还会把图像保存到该路径。 vis_rgb_mask_Coord_origin 返回两幅图像，保留了 img_path 参数，但不使用它写文件。常规推理可让 Tester 准备输入，再用上面的工具保存 show_* 图像。 源码： 裁剪图可视化 、 完整画布可视化 。 网络与 checkpoint PYTHON from HccePose.network_model import HccePose_BF_Net HccePose_BF_Net ( efficientnet_key = None , input_channels = 3 , min_xyz = None , size_xyz = None , ) network . inference_batch ( inputs , Bbox , thershold = 0.5 ) inputs 是归一化 BGR 裁剪张量，通常为 N × 3 × 256 × 256 。 Bbox 为 N × 4 张量，内容是对应图像画布中的 [x, y, width, height] 。 min_xyz 和 size_xyz 应描述物体轴对齐模型边界，并与运算张量的设备匹配。 调用时按接口的拼写传入 thershold ，用于对 sigmoid 后的掩码和编码设阈值。该接口返回稠密预测、解码后的模型坐标及 logits。要获得最终 Rts ，还需要检测和 PnP，见 结果字段 。 efficientnet_key=None 选择 ResNet，其余值选择 EfficientNet。 Checkpoint 工具也位于 HccePose.network_model ： PYTHON get_checkpoint ( path ) load_checkpoint ( check_point_path , net , optimizer = None , local_rank = 0 , CUDA_DEVICE = '0' , ) 两处路径都指向 checkpoint 目录 。 get_checkpoint() 解析文件名 step 前面的分数，返回最高分文件路径。 load_checkpoint() 加载 CUDA 权重及可选优化器状态，返回 best_score 、 iteration_step 、 keypoints_ 。当前加载器对无法加载的权重抛出明确异常，并提供物体编号、文件及原因。使用架构兼容的 checkpoint；不要将说明文件或旧权重混放在 best_score/ 中。 源码： 网络构造 、 批推理 、 checkpoint 选择 、 checkpoint 加载 。 训练与评测边界 训练和评测各有独立的 Python 脚本，参数在脚本内设置。仓库没有统一的 train() 或 evaluate() 接口。下表脚本位于 公开上游源码 根目录，并非当前项目的本地入口。 脚本 用途 s4_p2_train_bf_pbr.py 逐物体训练； ide_debug=True 为单卡， False 启用 DDP。数据集路径仍为占位值，需编辑。 s4_p2_test_bf_pbr.py 在已裁剪的 PBR 图像上验证网络预测和 PnP。 s4_p2_test_bf_pbr_bop_challenge.py 默认 LM-O 示例，使用外部 GDRNPP 检测，写入分割 JSON 和位姿 CSV，不调用官方评分器、不上传结果。 训练脚本使用 total_iteration=50001 、 batch_size=24 。训练时从同一 train_pbr 目录抽取 ratio=0.01 的样本监控进度。评测独立测试集时请使用相应的评测脚本。 BOP 脚本使用 efficientnet_key=1 、脚本列出的 LM-O 物体 ID 及该数据集的检测 JSON。它输出 seg2d_<dataset>.json 和 det6d_<dataset>.csv 供后续评分。两份文件的 time=-1 均为占位值；运行耗时需单独测量。 源码： 训练设置 、 PBR 验证 、 挑战设置 、 挑战输出 。

title: Utilities and advanced API
text: Utilities and advanced interfaces After running inference with Tester , use these helpers to save images and print stage timings. The lower-level interfaces below provide access to the network and checkpoints. See the results API for output shapes and units. Save visualization artifacts PYTHON from HccePose.test_script_utils import save_visual_artifacts save_visual_artifacts ( artifacts , enabled = True ) artifacts is an iterable of (path, image) pairs. Images use OpenCV BGR H × W × 3 ; use uint8 images when saving the tester outputs. With enabled=False , the helper returns [] without writing. It skips None paths/images, creates parent directories and calls cv2.imwrite() . PYTHON # output_dir is the chosen local output folder. import os saved_paths = save_visual_artifacts ([ ( os . path . join ( output_dir , 'pose.jpg' ), results . get ( 'show_6D_vis2' )), ( os . path . join ( output_dir , 'detection.jpg' ), results . get ( 'show_2D_results' )), ]) Existing files at the same path may be overwritten. The helper records each attempted path without checking the return value of cv2.imwrite() . Check the destination files when you need to confirm that writing succeeded. Source: save_visual_artifacts . Print stage times PYTHON from HccePose.test_script_utils import print_stage_time_breakdown print_stage_time_breakdown ( results_dict , enabled = False , prefix = '' ) Set enabled=True to print time , stage seconds and percentages. It returns None . Missing or malformed timing dictionaries print an unavailable message. Percentages use results_dict['time'] ; visualization can fall outside that interval, so percentages need not sum to 100%. See timing definitions . Source: print_stage_time_breakdown . Lower-level visualization PYTHON vis_rgb_mask_Coord ( rgb_c , pred_mask , pred_front_code , pred_back_code , img_path = None , ) vis_rgb_mask_Coord_origin ( cam_K , obj_ids_l , obj_ids_all , BBox_3d_l , Rts_l , conf_s , rgb_c , pred_mask , pred_front_code , pred_back_code , img_path = None , ) These functions live in HccePose.visualization . The first returns a crop/code canvas; the second returns (combined_canvas, compact_canvas) with model box projections. The inputs are normalized BGR tensors plus code/mask tensors. The second function requires masks and codes already warped into the image canvas and poses in the same model coordinate convention as BBox_3d_l . vis_rgb_mask_Coord returns the visualization and also writes it to disk when you supply img_path . vis_rgb_mask_Coord_origin returns two images and does not use its img_path argument. For normal inference, let Tester prepare the inputs and pass its show_* images to the saving helper above. Sources: crop visualization , full-canvas visualization . Network and checkpoints PYTHON from HccePose.network_model import HccePose_BF_Net HccePose_BF_Net ( efficientnet_key = None , input_channels = 3 , min_xyz = None , size_xyz = None , ) network . inference_batch ( inputs , Bbox , thershold = 0.5 ) inputs is a normalized BGR crop tensor, typically N × 3 × 256 × 256 . Bbox is a tensor N × 4 containing [x, y, width, height] in the associated image canvas. min_xyz and size_xyz must describe the object's axis-aligned model bounds and be compatible with the tensor device. Use the API spelling thershold to threshold the sigmoid mask and code values. The call returns dense predictions, decoded model coordinates and logits. Detection and PnP are separate steps for computing the final Rts . See result field shapes . efficientnet_key=None selects ResNet. Other values select EfficientNet. Checkpoint helpers are also in HccePose.network_model : PYTHON get_checkpoint ( path ) load_checkpoint ( check_point_path , net , optimizer = None , local_rank = 0 , CUDA_DEVICE = '0' , ) Both paths refer to a checkpoint directory . get_checkpoint() parses score prefixes before step and returns the highest-scoring file path. load_checkpoint() loads CUDA weights and optional optimizer state, returning best_score , iteration_step , and keypoints_ . The current loader raises clear errors for invalid checkpoints, including object, file and cause. Use architecture-compatible weights; keep notes and obsolete checkpoints out of best_score/ . Sources: network constructor , batch inference , checkpoint selection , checkpoint loading . Training and evaluation boundaries Training and evaluation have separate Python scripts. Set the parameters in the relevant script. There is no shared train() or evaluate() entry point. The scripts below live in the public upstream root , rather than the current project. Script Purpose s4_p2_train_bf_pbr.py Per-object training. ide_debug=True selects single-GPU mode; False enables DDP. The dataset path is a placeholder requiring editing. s4_p2_test_bf_pbr.py Evaluates the loaded network and PnP on cropped PBR images. s4_p2_test_bf_pbr_bop_challenge.py Default LM-O example with external GDRNPP detections; writes segmentation JSON and pose CSV. It does not invoke the official scorer or upload results. The training script sets total_iteration=50001 and batch_size=24 . To monitor training, it samples ratio=0.01 from the same train_pbr directory. Use the appropriate evaluation script for a held-out test set. The BOP script uses efficientnet_key=1 , the listed LM-O object IDs and the dataset's detection JSON. It writes seg2d_<dataset>.json and det6d_<dataset>.csv for subsequent scoring. Both files use a time=-1 placeholder. Measure runtime separately. Sources: training settings , PBR validation , challenge setup , challenge output .

title: BOP evaluation
text: BOP evaluation This page uses preparation, training or evaluation scripts from the public upstream source . Obtain that revision as described in Installation , and run these commands from its root. The current project’s examples/inference/ provides application inference. The evaluation script generates segmentation and pose predictions for the seven core BOP datasets. The supplied configuration uses LM-O, object IDs [1, 5, 6, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12] and efficientnet_key=1 . It reads the GDRNPP detections supplied for BOP 2023. To run on another dataset, update the dataset path, detection JSON and weights, and check the backbone setting. BASH python s4_p2_test_bf_pbr_bop_challenge.py For LM-O, the script writes two prediction files to the dataset directory. It puts -1 in the CSV runtime field to indicate that runtime was not measured. To obtain benchmark scores, evaluate the predictions with the official tools or submit them to BOP. Pretrained weights Dataset Weights LM-O Hugging Face - LM-O YCB-V Hugging Face - YCB-V T-LESS Hugging Face - T-LESS TUD-L Hugging Face - TUD-L HB Hugging Face - HB ITODD Hugging Face - ITODD IC-BIN Hugging Face - IC-BIN Some objects have a best checkpoint labeled iteration 0 . We train a front-surface HccePose model first and use its weights to initialize joint front and back training. Iteration 0 means those starting weights scored highest among the checkpoints evaluated in that run. LM-O submission results We submitted the following two files on October 20, 2025. The 6D localization score matched our 2024 submission. Fixes to the segmentation implementation improved the 2D segmentation score by 0.002. 2D segmentation results: seg2d_lmo.json 6D pose results: det6d_lmo.csv Historical leaderboard screenshots

title: Public changelog
text: Changelog June 2, 2026 The BOP Writer now uses pyrender with multiple processes to generate ground-truth masks and scene metadata. Source commit April 6, 2026 The installation guide added a minimal inference setup, first-run timing notes, troubleshooting and an optional requirements-inference.txt . The ONNX scripts may install dependencies automatically. Run them in a dedicated venv or conda environment. April 4, 2026 Added the MegaPose refinement interface and RGB-D examples. HccePose supports ONNX or TensorRT through hccepose_acceleration ; time_dict provides stage timings. Released RGB-D frames 000000 through 000003 . Each frame includes {stem}_rgb.png , {stem}_depth.png and {stem}_camK.json . See the sample files and download instructions . Pass OpenCV BGR images directly to Tester.predict ; MegaPose debug images are saved in BGR. October 28, 2025 Updated label generation. The PBR rendering script can create a default camera.json automatically. Rendering script October 27, 2025 Released cc0textures-512 , a texture library of about 600 MB that can replace the original 44 GB CC0Textures library in the rendering example. Historical roadmap The 2025 roadmap targeted the end of that year. It marked three items complete: weights for the seven core BOP datasets, the BOP Challenge evaluation workflow, and tutorials covering object preparation, rendering, YOLOv11 labels and training, and HccePose(BF) labels and training. Three items were still planned at the time: inter-frame pose tracking, real-scene pose dataset preparation with HccePose(BF), and training on a mix of PBR and real data. The video example in this repository runs inference independently on each frame.
